title: DelegateEval: Evaluating Platforms for Personal External Service Agents
title_zh: DelegateEval：面向个人外部服务智能体的平台评估

paragraphs.en: AI agents that work for an individual over time may also help that individual serve external clients. We define a personal external service agent as an agent authorized and continuously managed by a specific individual to accept client requests, deliver work, and provide ongoing support using that person’s knowledge, experience, professional methods, and service boundaries. Such agents could allow individuals to serve more clients with less direct involvement and generate economic value at scale. We propose DelegateEval, a platform-level evaluation framework for agent systems that may combine large language models, reusable skills, protocols such as MCP, and executable tool environments. It covers eight dimensions: ease of creation, service discovery and matching, delivery quality, expertise inheritance, service continuity, learning and improvement, reliability and governance, and efficiency and value. These dimensions assess whether a platform enables people with different backgrounds to turn their expertise into ongoing services that deliver verifiable work, develop capabilities through experience, and remain economically feasible. We present the framework and an experimental design. Complete datasets, executable environments, a unified scoring protocol, and cross-model results remain to be developed and empirically validated.
paragraphs.zh: 长期为某个个人服务的智能体也可以帮助该个人服务外部客户。 我们将个人外部服务智能体定义为：由特定个人授权并持续管理的智能体，该智能体运用此人的知识、经验、专业方法和服务边界，接受客户请求、交付工作并提供持续支持。 这类智能体可以让个人以更少的直接参与服务更多客户，并大规模创造经济价值。 我们提出 DelegateEval，一个面向智能体系统的平台级评估框架，此类系统可能结合大语言模型、可复用技能、MCP 等协议以及可执行的工具环境。 该框架涵盖八个维度：创建便捷性、服务发现与匹配、交付质量、专长传承、服务连续性、学习与改进、可靠性与治理，以及效率与价值。 这些维度评估一个平台能否让不同背景的人将自身专长转化为能够交付可验证工作、通过经验发展能力并在经济上可持续的持续服务。 我们给出该框架和一项实验设计。 完整的数据集、可执行环境、统一的评分协议以及跨模型的结果仍有待开发并通过实证验证。

paragraphs.en: A personal external service agent would allow an individual’s expertise to reach clients even when that person cannot take part in every task. An engineer’s code and debugging practices, or a teacher’s methods of explanation, could guide an agent’s work through configuration and continued development. We use the term for an agent authorized and continuously managed by a specific individual to use that person’s professional resources in serving external clients. Clients may submit requests themselves or through their personal assistants. Evaluation must establish whether the agent actually uses the individual’s expertise and honors client agreements with limited involvement from that individual.
paragraphs.zh: 个人外部服务智能体可以让个人的专业知识触达客户，即使此人无法参与每一项任务。 工程师的代码与调试实践，或教师的讲解方法，可以通过配置和持续开发来指导智能体的工作。 我们用这个术语指由特定个人授权并持续管理的智能体，它利用该人的专业资源来服务外部客户。 客户可以亲自提交请求，也可以通过他们的个人助理提交。 评估必须确定智能体是否真正运用了该人的专业知识，并在该人有限参与的情况下遵守与客户的约定。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation must follow the service beyond a single task. An engineer’s agent may deliver working code and still owe the client maintenance of an older version. It may later face changed requirements or withdrawn authorization. A platform must help people with different backgrounds establish services, help clients find suitable providers, and support the use of personal expertise across successive tasks. Tests must therefore check whether personal methods reduce domain errors, new requirements are reconciled with existing commitments, and feedback improves later work. They must also distinguish the contributions of the foundation model, personal resources, platform mechanisms, and additional human labor, and record the full cost of each. This makes it possible to assess whether quality, safety, and cost remain acceptable as the service grows.
paragraphs.zh: 评估必须超越单个任务，持续跟踪服务的全过程。 一位工程师的智能体可能交付了可运行的代码，但仍需为客户维护旧版本。 它之后可能面临需求变更或授权撤回的情况。 平台必须帮助不同背景的人建立服务，帮助客户找到合适的服务提供者，并支持个人专长在连续多个任务中的使用。 因此，测试必须检查个人方法是否能减少领域错误，新需求是否与既有承诺得到协调，以及反馈是否改进了后续工作。 测试还必须区分基础模型、个人资源、平台机制和额外人力劳动各自的贡献，并记录每一项的完整成本。 这使得评估服务质量、安全性和成本在服务增长过程中是否保持可接受成为可能。

paragraphs.en: We propose DelegateEval to evaluate service creation, individual service episodes, and service histories across tasks and time. Its eight dimensions use predefined requirements and independent verification, with service performance, accepted deliveries, safety incidents, human effort, and full costs reported separately. Records of technical configurations and operating conditions support comparisons across foundation models and implementations. Expertise inheritance tests how well a fixed version uses an individual’s professional resources; learning and improvement tests the additional benefit of updates based on authorized service experience. The present contribution is the framework and evaluation design, which will guide the development of datasets, execution environments, protocols, and cross-model experiments. The central question is whether a platform can help one person serve more clients while keeping quality acceptable and the provider’s workload and obligations sustainable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DelegateEval，用于评估服务创建、单项服务任务以及跨任务、跨时间的服务历史。 其八个维度采用预先定义的需求和独立验证，并分别报告服务表现、被接受的交付成果、安全事件、人工投入以及全部成本。 技术配置和运行条件的记录支持在不同基础模型和实现之间进行比较。 专长继承测试智能体的固定版本利用个人专业资源的能力如何；学习与提升测试基于授权服务经验的更新所带来的额外收益。 本文的贡献是框架和评估设计，它将指导数据集、执行环境、协议以及跨模型实验的开发。 核心问题是：一个平台能否帮助一个人服务更多客户，同时保持质量可接受，并使服务者的工作量和义务可持续。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes three contributions. First, it distinguishes personal assistants from personal external service agents and defines the responsibilities of principals, clients, agents, and platforms. Second, it proposes eight dimensions for evaluating a platform’s support for professional services, with separate measures of discovery, continuity, and learning. A technical inventory records implementation conditions so that different approaches can be tested against the same service objectives. Third, it sets out comparisons across principals, tasks, and time to assess ongoing delivery, fulfillment, learning, personal effort, economic returns, and risk as services grow.
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出三项贡献。 首先，本文区分了个人助理与个人外部服务智能体，并界定了委托人、客户端、智能体与平台各自的职责。 其次，本文提出了评估平台对专业服务支持程度的八个维度，并对发现、延续与学习分别进行衡量。 技术清单记录实现条件，使不同方法能够在相同的服务目标下进行检验。 最后，本文设定了跨委托人、跨任务与跨时间的比较，以评估服务增长过程中的持续交付、履约、学习、个人投入、经济回报与风险。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench evaluates code changes against real repository issues. AppWorld checks application state to determine whether a task was completed and whether unintended changes occurred. TheAgentCompany places file processing, software use, and collaboration with colleagues in a simulated organizational environment [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . tau-bench combines multi-turn interaction, tool use, business rules, and final-state evaluation, and examines consistency across repeated runs [ 5 ] . Together, these studies shift agent evaluation toward the work actually accomplished and provide a methodological basis for using concrete deliverables and independent acceptance checks.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 针对真实仓库中的问题评估代码改动。 AppWorld 通过检查应用状态来判断任务是否完成，以及是否发生了非预期的更改。 TheAgentCompany 将文件处理、软件使用以及与同事的协作置于一个模拟的组织环境中 [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。tau-bench 结合了多轮交互、工具使用、业务规则和最终状态评估，并考察多次运行之间的一致性 [ 5 ] 。 总体而言，这些研究将智能体评估转向实际完成的工作，并为使用具体交付成果和独立的验收检查提供了方法论基础。

paragraphs.en: Intelligent AI Delegation further emphasizes verifiability through task decomposition. Its contract-first approach requires task granularity to match the available verification methods: a subtask whose outcome is too subjective, complex, or difficult to verify reliably should be decomposed recursively until completion can be established through automated tests, formal proofs, or another suitable verification mechanism [ 11 ] . Task decomposition must therefore consider how completion will be demonstrated as well as how the work will be done.
paragraphs.zh: 智能AI委派通过任务分解进一步强调可验证性。 其契约优先的方法要求任务粒度与可用的验证方法相匹配：如果某个子任务的结果过于主观、复杂或难以可靠验证，则应递归地进行分解，直到能够通过自动化测试、形式化证明或其他合适的验证机制来确定其完成 [ 11 ]。 因此，任务分解不仅必须考虑如何完成工作，还必须考虑如何证明工作已经完成。

paragraphs.en: DelegateEval applies these verification principles to platforms that support multiple individual providers. It tests whether people can establish their own services and whether those services remain verifiable and fulfill existing commitments as tasks, feedback, and environments change.

paragraphs.en: Long-term service requires agents to use past information correctly and improve through experience. LongMemEval studies long-term memory abilities such as information extraction across sessions, temporal reasoning, and knowledge updates [ 6 ] . LoRA and DPO provide methods for parameter-efficient adaptation and preference learning, respectively, supporting continued model adjustment [ 7 , 8 ] . SOTOPIA studies social interaction among agents, Magentic Marketplace studies market behavior between consumer and merchant agents, and Intelligent AI Delegation examines authorization, responsibility, and role boundaries in delegated work [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . These lines of research offer relevant perspectives on memory, learning, and multi-party collaboration for sustained services.
paragraphs.zh: 长期服务要求智能体正确使用过去的信息并通过经验不断改进。 LongMemEval 研究跨会话的信息提取、时间推理和知识更新等长期记忆能力 [ 6 ] 。 LoRA 和 DPO 分别提供了参数高效适配与偏好学习的方法，支持模型的持续调整 [ 7 , 8 ] 。 SOTOPIA 研究智能体之间的社会互动，Magentic Marketplace 研究消费者智能体与商家智能体之间的市场行为，Intelligent AI Delegation 则考察委托工作中的授权、责任与角色边界 [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。 这些研究方向为持续服务中的记忆、学习和多方协作提供了相关视角。

paragraphs.en: Trainable add-on parametric memory provides another route to knowledge adaptation with a frozen foundation model. Wei et al.’s Deep Fusion Memory (DFM) trains a memory predictor using text-chunk embeddings obtained through offline retrieval and fuses predicted memories into intermediate hidden states through gated cross-attention. The foundation model remains frozen while the added memory-prediction and fusion modules are jointly optimized. At inference time, explicit retrieval from the external corpus is no longer required [ 22 ] . Here, an add-on is a trainable module within the model’s computation, rather than a separate small model that independently answers questions.
paragraphs.zh: 可训练的外挂参数化记忆为在冻结基础模型的情况下实现知识适配提供了另一条路径。 Wei 等人的深度融合记忆（DFM）利用通过离线检索获得的文本块嵌入训练一个记忆预测器，并通过门控交叉注意力将预测出的记忆融合到中间隐藏状态中。 基础模型保持冻结，而新增的记忆预测与融合模块则被联合优化。 在推理时，不再需要从外部语料库进行显式检索 [ 22 ] 。 这里的外挂是指模型计算内部的一个可训练模块，而不是独立回答问题的单独小型模型。

paragraphs.en: SocialReasoning-Bench evaluates both outcomes and the decisions that lead to them. In scheduling and negotiation tasks, it checks whether agents use available information and explore suitable alternatives [ 12 ] . This matters for personal external service agents, which must represent a specific principal while managing existing agreements, later feedback, and changing client relationships. DelegateEval examines these decisions across tasks and time and compares whether a platform supports different principals’ professional requirements consistently.
paragraphs.zh: SocialReasoning-Bench 同时评估结果以及导致这些结果的决策。 在调度与谈判任务中，它检验智能体是否利用可用信息并探索合适的替代方案 [ 12 ]。 这对个人外部服务智能体而言十分重要，这类智能体必须在代表特定委托人的同时，管理既有协议、后续反馈以及不断变化的客户关系。 DelegateEval 跨任务、跨时间考察这些决策，并比较一个平台是否能持续支持不同委托人的专业需求。

paragraphs.en: AgentDojo provides an executable environment for studying attacks and defenses involving untrusted inputs, including prompt injection [ 13 ] . For agent collaboration, A2A specifies interoperability mechanisms for exchanging tasks, status, and artifacts, providing an interface basis for service discovery, delegation, and delivery across agents [ 14 ] . These efforts address safety and collaboration within agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: AgentDojo 提供了一个可执行环境，用于研究涉及不可信输入的攻击与防御，包括提示注入 [ 13 ]。 在智能体协作方面，A2A 规定了交换任务、状态和产出的互操作机制，为跨智能体的服务发现、委托与交付提供了接口基础 [ 14 ]。 这些工作解决的是智能体系统内部的安全与协作问题。

sents.zh: AgentDojo 提供了一个可执行环境，用于研究涉及不可信输入的攻击与防御，包括提示注入 [ 13 ]。

sents.en: For agent collaboration, A2A specifies interoperability mechanisms for exchanging tasks, status, and artifacts, providing an interface basis for service discovery, delegation, and delivery across agents [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: 在智能体协作方面，A2A 规定了交换任务、状态和产出的互操作机制，为跨智能体的服务发现、委托与交付提供了接口基础 [ 14 ]。

sents.en: These efforts address safety and collaboration within agent systems.
sents.zh: 这些工作解决的是智能体系统内部的安全与协作问题。

paragraphs.en: For DelegateEval, these mechanisms matter when they help clients find services, request work, receive deliverables, and obtain follow-up support from agents representing different individuals. Evaluation tests their contribution to those outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 DelegateEval，当这些机制有助于客户找到服务、请求工作、接收交付成果，并从代表不同个体的智能体那里获得后续支持时，它们才具有重要意义。 评估检验的是它们对这些成果的贡献。

sents.en: For DelegateEval, these mechanisms matter when they help clients find services, request work, receive deliverables, and obtain follow-up support from agents representing different individuals.
sents.zh: 对于 DelegateEval，当这些机制有助于客户找到服务、请求工作、接收交付成果，并从代表不同个体的智能体那里获得后续支持时，它们才具有重要意义。

sents.zh: 评估检验的是它们对这些成果的贡献。

paragraphs.en: A personal external service agent is an agent authorized by a specific individual that incorporates that person’s knowledge, experience, preferences, methods, and service boundaries to provide ongoing services to external clients.
paragraphs.zh: 个人外部服务智能体是由特定个人授权的智能体，它融合该个人的知识、经验、偏好、方法与服务边界，为外部客户提供持续服务。

paragraphs.en: Throughout this paper, the principal is the specific individual represented by the agent. The agent represents that individual, not the individual’s employer or another organization.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，委托人是智能体所代表的具体个人。 智能体代表的是该个人，而不是该个人的雇主或其他组织。

sents.en: Throughout this paper, the principal is the specific individual represented by the agent.
sents.zh: 在本文中，委托人是智能体所代表的具体个人。

sents.en: The agent represents that individual, not the individual’s employer or another organization.
sents.zh: 智能体代表的是该个人，而不是该个人的雇主或其他组织。

paragraphs.en: A personal assistant works for me; a personal external service agent provides services to others on my behalf. A programmer’s personal assistant helps the programmer write code, whereas the programmer’s external service agent interacts with external clients, accepts software development requests, and delivers work on the programmer’s behalf. Access may be public or restricted to authenticated existing clients.
paragraphs.zh: 个人助理为我工作；而个人对外服务智能体代表我向他人提供服务。 程序员的个人助理帮助程序员编写代码，而程序员的外部服务智能体则与外部客户交互，接受软件开发请求，并代表程序员交付工作成果。 访问可以是公开的，也可以仅限于经过身份验证的现有客户。

sents.en: A personal assistant works for me; a personal external service agent provides services to others on my behalf.
sents.zh: 个人助理为我工作；而个人对外服务智能体代表我向他人提供服务。

sents.en: A programmer’s personal assistant helps the programmer write code, whereas the programmer’s external service agent interacts with external clients, accepts software development requests, and delivers work on the programmer’s behalf.
sents.zh: 程序员的个人助理帮助程序员编写代码，而程序员的外部服务智能体则与外部客户交互，接受软件开发请求，并代表程序员交付工作成果。

sents.en: Access may be public or restricted to authenticated existing clients.
sents.zh: 访问可以是公开的，也可以仅限于经过身份验证的现有客户。

paragraphs.en: We denote the individual principal by p, an external client by c, and the principal’s personal external service agent by a p a_{p} . The principal determines the service scope, professional methods, knowledge sources, data boundaries, and management rules. The client submits tasks, supplies materials, confirms requirements, and accepts deliverables. The agent follows the requirements that each party is entitled to set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用 p 表示委托人本人，用 c 表示外部客户，用 a_p（a_{p}）表示委托人的个人外部服务智能体。 委托人决定服务范围、专业方法、知识来源、数据边界和管理规则。 客户提交任务、提供材料、确认需求并验收交付物。 智能体遵循各方有权设定的要求。

sents.en: We denote the individual principal by p, an external client by c, and the principal’s personal external service agent by a p a_{p} .
sents.zh: 我们用 p 表示委托人本人，用 c 表示外部客户，用 a_p（a_{p}）表示委托人的个人外部服务智能体。

sents.en: The principal determines the service scope, professional methods, knowledge sources, data boundaries, and management rules.
sents.zh: 委托人决定服务范围、专业方法、知识来源、数据边界和管理规则。

sents.en: The client submits tasks, supplies materials, confirms requirements, and accepts deliverables.
sents.zh: 客户提交任务、提供材料、确认需求并验收交付物。

sents.en: The agent follows the requirements that each party is entitled to set.
sents.zh: 智能体遵循各方有权设定的要求。

paragraphs.en: The client c may interact with the service directly or authorize a personal assistant or another agent to find services, submit requests, communicate requirements, and receive results. The client remains the person or organization requesting the service, even when another agent handles the interaction. The service beneficiary, the parties represented, and their responsibilities must remain clear. An agent acting for the client may confirm changes or accept results only within that client’s authorization.
paragraphs.zh: 客户 c 可以直接与服务交互，或授权个人助理或其他智能体来查找服务、提交请求、传达需求并接收结果。 即使由另一个智能体处理交互，客户仍然是请求服务的个人或组织。 服务受益人、所代表的各方及其职责必须保持清晰。 代表客户行事的智能体只能在该客户的授权范围内确认变更或接受结果。

sents.en: The client c may interact with the service directly or authorize a personal assistant or another agent to find services, submit requests, communicate requirements, and receive results.
sents.zh: 客户 c 可以直接与服务交互，或授权个人助理或其他智能体来查找服务、提交请求、传达需求并接收结果。

sents.en: The client remains the person or organization requesting the service, even when another agent handles the interaction.
sents.zh: 即使由另一个智能体处理交互，客户仍然是请求服务的个人或组织。

sents.en: The service beneficiary, the parties represented, and their responsibilities must remain clear.
sents.zh: 服务受益人、所代表的各方及其职责必须保持清晰。

sents.en: An agent acting for the client may confirm changes or accept results only within that client’s authorization.
sents.zh: 代表客户行事的智能体只能在该客户的授权范围内确认变更或接受结果。

paragraphs.en: Clients may adjust requirements for a particular deliverable, while the principal manages global service rules. If the principal changes the scope of the service, previously accepted work must still be addressed. Client materials and the principal’s private knowledge are managed separately; use for the current task, retention across tasks, and model training require purpose-specific permission. If requirements conflict, the agent should seek clarification, negotiate, or request guidance, and record how existing commitments will be fulfilled or changed.
paragraphs.zh: 客户可以针对某个特定交付物调整需求，而委托方负责管理全局服务规则。 如果委托方变更了服务的范围，之前已接受的工作仍必须得到处理。 客户材料与委托方的私有知识须分开管理；将其用于当前任务、跨任务保留以及用于模型训练，都需要针对特定目的的许可。 如果需求发生冲突，智能体应当寻求澄清、进行协商或请求指导，并记录现有承诺将如何被履行或变更。

sents.en: Clients may adjust requirements for a particular deliverable, while the principal manages global service rules.
sents.zh: 客户可以针对某个特定交付物调整需求，而委托方负责管理全局服务规则。

sents.en: If the principal changes the scope of the service, previously accepted work must still be addressed.
sents.zh: 如果委托方变更了服务的范围，之前已接受的工作仍必须得到处理。

sents.en: Client materials and the principal’s private knowledge are managed separately; use for the current task, retention across tasks, and model training require purpose-specific permission.
sents.zh: 客户材料与委托方的私有知识须分开管理；将其用于当前任务、跨任务保留以及用于模型训练，都需要针对特定目的的许可。

paragraphs.en: The personal external service agent a p a_{p} is a service role with explicit authorization and action boundaries. It is not voice or personality imitation and does not imply that the agent has independent legal personhood. Professional licensing and responsibility must be assessed separately.
paragraphs.zh: 个人外部服务智能体 a p a_{p} 是一种具有明确授权和行动边界的服务角色。 它不是语音或人格模仿，也不意味着该智能体具有独立的法律人格。 专业执业资质与责任必须单独评估。

sents.en: The personal external service agent a p a_{p} is a service role with explicit authorization and action boundaries.
sents.zh: 个人外部服务智能体 a p a_{p} 是一种具有明确授权和行动边界的服务角色。

paragraphs.en: Task capabilities and service roles classify agents along different axes. Coding, document editing, and video production describe what an agent can do. Personal assistants and personal external service agents describe whom it works for and the service relationships it enters. One system may perform several roles.
paragraphs.zh: 任务能力与服务角色从不同维度对智能体进行分类。 编程、文档编辑和视频制作描述的是智能体能做什么。 个人助理和个人外部服务智能体描述的是它为谁服务以及所建立的服务关系。 一个系统可能承担多种角色。

paragraphs.en: Booking a hotel, contacting merchants, or sending email on an individual’s behalf can remain the work of a personal assistant. The external service relationship studied here arises when an external client submits a development request and an individual provider’s agent accepts it and fulfills the associated obligations over time. Being continuously online, running in the cloud, or sending external messages does not by itself determine the role. When roles overlap, identities, materials, permissions, and records must be managed separately.
paragraphs.zh: 代个人预订酒店、联系商家或发送邮件，仍可属于个人助理的职责范围。 本文研究的外部服务关系是指：外部客户提交开发请求，而个体提供者的智能体接受该请求，并随时间履行相关义务。 持续在线、在云端运行或发送外部消息，本身并不决定角色。 当角色重叠时，身份、材料、权限和记录必须分开管理。

sents.en: Being continuously online, running in the cloud, or sending external messages does not by itself determine the role.

sents.zh: 当角色重叠时，身份、材料、权限和记录必须分开管理。

paragraphs.en: Customer-support, sales, and merchant agents that represent companies or other organizations fall outside this paper’s scope. Even if a platform supports such uses, this framework evaluates only its support for services provided on behalf of individuals.
paragraphs.zh: 代表公司或其他组织的客服、销售及商家智能体不在本文的讨论范围内。 即使某个平台支持此类用途，本框架也仅评估其对代表个人提供的服务之支持情况。

paragraphs.en: For example, a software engineer’s client may request changes to the current deliverable, but may not require the agent to read the engineer’s private email, disclose another client’s code, or permanently rewrite global development rules. Treating external client messages as principal instructions confuses authority; following only the principal’s latest preferences may overlook delivery requirements already agreed with the client. These cases motivate role-switching tests.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，软件工程师的客户可能要求修改当前交付物，但不应要求智能体读取工程师的私人邮件、泄露另一客户的代码，或永久重写全局开发规则。 把外部客户的消息当作委托人的指令会造成权限混淆；而只遵循委托人最新的偏好，则可能忽略已与客户商定的交付要求。 这些情况引出了角色切换测试的动机。

sents.zh: 这些情况引出了角色切换测试的动机。

paragraphs.en: A platform helps individuals create, integrate, configure, publish, run, and manage their agents, and gives external clients a way to request work and receive results. It must identify whom each agent represents and explain the services offered. Depending on the service and the platform’s purpose, it may also support continued capability development, public search, payment, collaboration with agents on other platforms, or local deployment. These additional functions are not required in every setting.
paragraphs.zh: 一个平台可帮助个人创建、集成、配置、发布、运行和管理其智能体，并为外部客户端提供一种请求工作并接收结果的方式。 它必须识别每个智能体所代表的人，并说明所提供的服务。 根据服务和平台的目的，它还可以支持持续的能力开发、公开搜索、支付、与其他平台上的智能体协作，或本地部署。 这些附加功能并非在每种场景下都是必需的。

sents.zh: 一个平台可帮助个人创建、集成、配置、发布、运行和管理其智能体，并为外部客户端提供一种请求工作并接收结果的方式。

paragraphs.en: The platform operator provides infrastructure and establishes platform rules without overriding data-use boundaries. Training, long-term retention, or other uses of principal or client data still require the relevant permission. Human configuration, review, verification, and operational support supplied by the platform must be recorded and included in service costs rather than conflated with work performed independently by the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 平台运营方提供基础设施并制定平台规则，但不得凌驾于数据使用边界之上。 对委托方或客户数据进行训练、长期留存或其他使用，仍需获得相关许可。 平台提供的人工配置、审查、核验和运营支持必须被记录并计入服务成本，而不得与智能体独立完成的工作混为一谈。

sents.zh: 平台运营方提供基础设施并制定平台规则，但不得凌驾于数据使用边界之上。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish the model, the agent, and the platform. The model provides basic reasoning, generation, and decision-making capabilities. The personal external service agent combines those capabilities with an individual’s knowledge, experience, methods, tools, and service boundaries. The platform helps different individuals create and manage these services over time. DelegateEval evaluates that support using evidence from service creation, delivery, and subsequent tasks. A system that provides only part of this support may take the relevant component tests, but conclusions must remain limited to the functions tested.
paragraphs.zh: 我们区分模型、智能体和平台。 模型提供基础的推理、生成和决策能力。 个人外部服务智能体将这些能力与个人的知识、经验、方法、工具和服务边界相结合。 平台帮助不同的个人随时间创建和管理这些服务。 DelegateEval 利用服务创建、交付及后续任务中的证据来评估这种支持。 仅提供部分支持的系统可以参加相关组件的测试，但结论必须仅限于所测试的功能。

sents.en: We distinguish the model, the agent, and the platform.
sents.zh: 我们区分模型、智能体和平台。

sents.en: The model provides basic reasoning, generation, and decision-making capabilities.
sents.zh: 模型提供基础的推理、生成和决策能力。

sents.en: The personal external service agent combines those capabilities with an individual’s knowledge, experience, methods, tools, and service boundaries.
sents.zh: 个人外部服务智能体将这些能力与个人的知识、经验、方法、工具和服务边界相结合。

sents.en: The platform helps different individuals create and manage these services over time.
sents.zh: 平台帮助不同的个人随时间创建和管理这些服务。

sents.en: DelegateEval evaluates that support using evidence from service creation, delivery, and subsequent tasks.

sents.zh: 仅提供部分支持的系统可以参加相关组件的测试，但结论必须仅限于所测试的功能。

paragraphs.en: Personal external service agents could give clients access to services that reflect an individual’s expertise, with verifiable deliverables and someone responsible for follow-up. Providers can build retrieval knowledge bases from authorized proprietary materials, encode their methods in reusable skills and workflows, and combine general-purpose language models with smaller domain models and specialized tools. Where model access and training resources permit, they can also adapt model or add-on parameters through fine-tuning or other post-training methods. Later service feedback can inform updates to knowledge, workflows, and configurations. Even with the same foundation model, providers may therefore differ in their sources, professional judgment, execution, and delivery standards.
paragraphs.zh: 个人外部服务智能体可以让客户获得体现个人专业能力的服务，具有可验证的交付成果，并有专人负责后续跟进。 服务提供者可以基于经授权的专有材料构建检索知识库，将其方法编码为可复用的技能与工作流，并将通用语言模型与更小的领域模型及专用工具相结合。 在模型访问权限和训练资源允许的情况下，他们还可以通过微调或其他后训练方法调整模型或附加参数。 后续的服务反馈可以为知识、工作流和配置的更新提供依据。 因此，即使使用相同的基础模型，不同提供者在信息来源、专业判断、执行和交付标准上也可能各不相同。

paragraphs.en: Clients using general-purpose tools such as ChatGPT or Codex directly often have to write prompts, break down tasks, select tools, and work through repeated attempts. A provider’s agent could reduce that effort, while the provider takes responsibility for professional judgment, verification, and revisions within the agreed scope. Clients without domain expertise may struggle to judge an answer: code that runs may break existing functionality, a polished report may use the wrong analytical definitions, and a complete mathematical solution may leave a student confused. Turning generated content into usable work requires appropriate methods, checks, and revisions.
paragraphs.zh: 直接使用 ChatGPT 或 Codex 等通用工具的客户，往往需要自己编写提示词、拆解任务、选择工具，并经历反复尝试。 服务提供方的智能体可以减少这类工作量，同时由提供方在约定范围内对专业判断、验证和修改承担责任。 缺乏领域专业知识的客户可能难以判断一个答案：能运行的代码可能破坏现有功能，一份精美的报告可能使用了错误的分析口径，一份完整的数学解答可能让学生依然困惑。 要把生成的内容转化为可用的工作成果，需要采用合适的方法、检查和修改。

sents.en: Clients using general-purpose tools such as ChatGPT or Codex directly often have to write prompts, break down tasks, select tools, and work through repeated attempts.

sents.zh: 要把生成的内容转化为可用的工作成果，需要采用合适的方法、检查和修改。

paragraphs.en: In this supply-side human-in-the-loop arrangement, the agent handles repeatable work and the provider reviews results, makes key decisions, or takes over exceptions as needed. Platforms should record which outputs received automated checks, human spot checks, or the provider’s approval, and the effort involved. An agent representing an expert does not imply that the expert reviews every output.
paragraphs.zh: 在这种供给侧的人在回路安排中，智能体负责可重复的工作，服务提供者则审查结果、做出关键决策，或在必要时接管异常情况。 平台应记录哪些输出经过了自动检查、人工抽查或服务提供者的批准，以及所投入的工作量。 智能体代表某位专家，并不意味着该专家会审查每一项输出。

sents.en: In this supply-side human-in-the-loop arrangement, the agent handles repeatable work and the provider reviews results, makes key decisions, or takes over exceptions as needed.
sents.zh: 在这种供给侧的人在回路安排中，智能体负责可重复的工作，服务提供者则审查结果、做出关键决策，或在必要时接管异常情况。

sents.zh: 智能体代表某位专家，并不意味着该专家会审查每一项输出。

paragraphs.en: An agent could also coordinate a provider’s computing equipment, production tools, robots, or in-person work. Within the principal’s authorization, this would extend services beyond the predominantly digital tasks supported by tools such as ChatGPT, Codex, and Claude Code. For example, a client could submit a design to an agent connected to the provider’s 3D printer. The agent could clarify requirements, generate and check a model, schedule production, and control the printer. A robotic arm could then remove, sort, and package finished items, while the agent arranges courier pickup.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体还可以协调委托方的计算设备、生产工具、机器人或线下人工工作。 在委托方的授权范围内，这将把服务扩展到 ChatGPT、Codex 和 Claude Code 等工具所支持的以数字任务为主的范围之外。 例如，客户可以将一份设计提交给连接到委托方 3D 打印机的智能体。 该智能体可以澄清需求、生成并检查模型、安排生产，并控制打印机。 随后，机械臂可以取下、分拣并包装成品，同时智能体安排快递取件。

sents.zh: 智能体还可以协调委托方的计算设备、生产工具、机器人或线下人工工作。

paragraphs.en: Spare computers, such as a Mac mini or GPU server, could similarly offer software builds, code testing, or model inference to external clients under appropriate resource isolation and authorization. Owners of drones, cameras, and other automated devices could accept relevant requests and coordinate equipment use. For ride-hailing drivers, domestic workers, and renovation contractors, an agent could handle client acquisition, communication, bookings, quotes, and follow-up while the provider performs the in-person work. Coordinating these resources could improve utilization and help individuals operate ongoing services that combine digital and physical work.
paragraphs.zh: 闲置的电脑，例如 Mac mini 或 GPU 服务器，同样可以在适当的资源隔离和授权下，向外部客户提供建构、代码测试或模型推理服务。 无人机、相机和其他自动化设备的主人可以接受相关请求并协调设备使用。 对于网约车司机、家政人员和装修承包商，智能体可以负责获客、沟通、预约、报价和跟进，而服务提供者则执行现场工作。 协调这些资源可以提高利用率，并帮助个人运营结合数字与实体工作的持续性服务。

paragraphs.en: Many professional services continue after the first delivery. Software needs maintenance, business reports need new data, a video series needs a consistent style, and tutoring must adapt to a student’s progress. Over 30 to 90 days, an early misunderstanding or missing project state can affect many later actions. Without checks at intermediate stages, results may drift from the client’s goals.
paragraphs.zh: 许多专业服务在首次交付之后仍会继续。 软件需要维护，商业报告需要新数据，视频系列需要统一的风格，而辅导必须适应学生的学习进度。 在30到90天的时间里，早期的误解或缺失的项目状态可能会影响许多后续行动。 如果没有在中间阶段进行检查，结果可能会偏离客户的目标。

sents.en: Many professional services continue after the first delivery.
sents.zh: 许多专业服务在首次交付之后仍会继续。

sents.en: Software needs maintenance, business reports need new data, a video series needs a consistent style, and tutoring must adapt to a student’s progress.
sents.zh: 软件需要维护，商业报告需要新数据，视频系列需要统一的风格，而辅导必须适应学生的学习进度。

sents.en: Over 30 to 90 days, an early misunderstanding or missing project state can affect many later actions.
sents.zh: 在30到90天的时间里，早期的误解或缺失的项目状态可能会影响许多后续行动。

sents.en: Without checks at intermediate stages, results may drift from the client’s goals.
sents.zh: 如果没有在中间阶段进行检查，结果可能会偏离客户的目标。

paragraphs.en: Within the principal’s authorization and client agreements, the system must track objectives, deliverable versions, unresolved issues, maintenance schedules, and follow-up responsibilities. Checks at agreed stages, anomaly detection, and human review can help correct deviations. Providers still need to exercise professional judgment and intervene as requirements or environments change. An agent may also act proactively within its authority, for example by checking compatibility after a dependency changes, preparing a revised report when new business data arrive, or adapting exercises after repeated student errors. Such follow-up could reduce the client’s effort in identifying problems, explaining the context again, and requesting further work.
paragraphs.zh: 在委托人授权和客户协议范围内，系统必须跟踪目标、交付物版本、未解决问题、维护计划和后续职责。 在约定阶段的检查、异常检测以及人工审查可以帮助纠正偏差。 当需求或环境发生变化时，提供者仍需运用专业判断并进行干预。 智能体也可以在其权限范围内主动采取行动，例如在依赖项变更后检查兼容性、在新的业务数据到达时准备修订后的报告，或在学生反复出错后调整练习。 这样的后续跟进可以减少客户在发现问题、再次说明背景以及请求进一步工作方面的精力投入。

sents.en: Providers still need to exercise professional judgment and intervene as requirements or environments change.
sents.zh: 当需求或环境发生变化时，提供者仍需运用专业判断并进行干预。

sents.en: An agent may also act proactively within its authority, for example by checking compatibility after a dependency changes, preparing a revised report when new business data arrive, or adapting exercises after repeated student errors.

sents.zh: 这样的后续跟进可以减少客户在发现问题、再次说明背景以及请求进一步工作方面的精力投入。

paragraphs.en: Personal external service agents could also act as specialists that a client’s personal assistant calls on. Individual providers could offer interfaces through which assistants request professional work. The assistant would interpret the client’s goals, select services, coordinate tasks, and organize acceptance checks; the provider and external service agent would perform the specialized work and support delivery.

paragraphs.en: DelegateEval tests whether these potential benefits hold in practice: can clients obtain verifiable work and continued maintenance, and can individuals serve more clients while preserving their professional methods and service boundaries?
paragraphs.zh: DelegateEval 检验这些潜在收益在实践中是否成立：客户能否获得可验证的工作成果和持续的维护支持，个人（智能体）能否在服务更多客户的同时，保留其专业方法与服务边界？

paragraphs.en: DelegateEval evaluates whether a platform helps people with different backgrounds use their expertise to provide reliable, ongoing services to more clients. It follows the full service lifecycle: creating and configuring an agent; helping clients find, select, and commission it; delivering and maintaining the work; and improving through experience while responding to changes in requirements, authorization, and the external environment. This section defines the evaluation target, framework, and scope. Section 6 explains the eight service-quality dimensions. Test protocols, scoring procedures, and decision rules remain for future work.
paragraphs.zh: DelegateEval 评估一个平台是否能帮助不同背景的人利用自身专长，为更多客户提供可靠、持续的服务。 它覆盖完整的服务生命周期：创建与配置智能体；帮助客户查找、选择并委托智能体；交付并维护工作成果；以及通过经验持续改进，同时响应需求、授权和外部环境的变化。 本节定义评估目标、框架与范围。 第 6 节解释八个服务质量维度。 测试协议、评分流程与决策规则留待后续工作。

paragraphs.en: DelegateEval asks whether a platform enables people from different backgrounds to build sustainable services around their expertise. Many potential providers have domain knowledge, business materials, and practical experience but little experience in agent development or system administration. Even with AI-assisted programming, building a system that accepts client requests, invokes tools, protects client data, and delivers work consistently is demanding. A platform can help with setup and routine management, including agent creation, knowledge configuration, and authorization, so that providers can concentrate on their professional work. Evaluation must therefore include the effort needed to set up and operate a service.
paragraphs.zh: DelegateEval 关注的是一个平台是否能够让不同背景的人围绕自己的专业知识构建可持续的服务。 许多潜在的服务提供者拥有领域知识、业务资料和实践经验，但在智能体开发或系统管理方面经验很少。 即使借助 AI 辅助编程，构建一个能够接收客户请求、调用工具、保护客户数据并稳定交付成果的系统仍然颇具挑战。 平台可以在搭建和日常管理方面提供帮助，包括智能体创建、知识配置和授权，使服务提供者能够专注于自己的专业工作。 因此，评估必须包含搭建和运营一项服务所需的投入。

paragraphs.en: Once established, a service must be discoverable, earn trust, and build a reputation through repeated commissions. Platforms can help clients find and compare services and support providers in building credibility through verifiable delivery records, client feedback, and fulfillment history. These functions affect whether individuals can sustain a service and cannot be inferred from one agent’s task performance. DelegateEval therefore treats the platform as the primary target, asking whether it helps different individuals establish services, obtain commissions, deliver reliably, and build credibility. Individual agents’ task outcomes provide evidence for that platform-level assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 服务一经建立，必须能够被发现、赢得信任，并通过反复受托建立声誉。 平台可以帮助客户发现和比较服务，并通过可验证的交付记录、客户反馈和履约历史，支持服务提供者建立可信度。 这些功能影响个人能否持续经营一项服务，且无法从单个智能体的任务表现中推断出来。 因此，DelegateEval 将平台作为主要评估对象，考察它是否帮助不同个体建立服务、获得委托、可靠交付并建立可信度。 各个智能体的任务结果为这种平台层面的评估提供证据。

paragraphs.en: The technical inventory documents how a system is implemented and the conditions under which it was tested. It supports interpretation and replication; it does not contribute to the score. The record covers post-training, proprietary models, retrieval, state management, execution environments, event triggers, and human involvement, along with the materials, permissions, and resources used in the run. Different implementations may achieve the same service goal: post-training and revised checking procedures can both improve later tasks, while either a memory module or a project database may preserve continuity. DelegateEval does not favor one approach in advance. It distinguishes what a system supports, what it actually used in a test, and whether that use improved service. Scores reflect performance in the relevant dimension, not technology names, feature counts, or implementation complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 技术清单记录了系统的实现方式以及对其进行测试的条件。 它支持解释与复现；它不计入分数。 该记录涵盖后训练、专有模型、检索、状态管理、执行环境、事件触发器以及人类参与，以及运行中所使用的材料、权限和资源。 不同的实现可能达成相同的服务目标：后训练与修订后的检查流程都可以改善后续任务，而记忆模块或项目数据库都可能保留连续性。 DelegateEval 不会预先偏向某一种方法。 它区分系统支持什么、在测试中实际使用了什么，以及该使用是否改善了服务。 分数反映相关维度上的表现，而不是技术名称、功能数量或实现复杂度。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation starts when an individual first creates a service, rather than after the agent has been configured. Creation records cover identity binding, configuration, publication, and later management. Interface scripts test whether the functions work. Tests with real creators establish whether they understand the process, can configure the service correctly, and can find and fix errors. These two sources of evidence answer different questions and are recorded separately.
paragraphs.zh: 评估从个人首次创建服务时开始，而不是在智能体配置完成之后。 创建记录涵盖身份绑定、配置、发布以及后续管理。 接口脚本用于测试各项功能是否正常工作。 通过真实创建者进行的测试可以确定他们是否理解流程、能否正确配置服务，以及能否发现并修复错误。 这两类证据来源回答的是不同的问题，因此被分别记录。

paragraphs.en: A service episode covers one client request from the initial commission to its outcome. It includes any necessary clarification, execution, checking, delivery, and revision, and ends when the task is completed, cancelled, or marked as pending. The task rules define these endpoints in advance without prescribing how the agent must do the work. A code change, a presentation, or a mathematics tutoring session can each form a complete episode. The episode record shows whether the requested work was completed and delivered.
paragraphs.zh: 一次服务情节覆盖从最初委托到其结果的一个客户请求。 它包括任何必要的澄清、执行、检查、交付和修订，并在任务完成、取消或被标记为待办时结束。 任务规则预先定义了这些端点，但不规定智能体必须如何完成工作。 一次代码修改、一份演示文稿或一节数学辅导课都可以各自构成一个完整的情节。 情节记录显示所请求的工作是否已完成并交付。

sents.en: A service episode covers one client request from the initial commission to its outcome.
sents.zh: 一次服务情节覆盖从最初委托到其结果的一个客户请求。

sents.en: It includes any necessary clarification, execution, checking, delivery, and revision, and ends when the task is completed, cancelled, or marked as pending.

paragraphs.en: A longitudinal service record establishes whether matters are handled correctly across tasks and time. It links one principal’s service episodes and intervening external events in temporal order. Multiple clients may be involved, and tasks may overlap. Earlier artifacts, commitments, valid permissions, and history that the system is authorized to retain may affect later decisions. For example, a request received on day 50 may need to be handled in light of an agreement made on day 3, an authorization updated on day 20, and a dispute arising on day 45.
paragraphs.zh: 纵向服务记录用于确认各项事务是否在不同任务和不同时间上得到正确处理。 它按时间顺序将同一委托人的各次服务事件及其间发生的外部事件关联起来。 其中可能涉及多个客户，任务也可能相互重叠。 系统被授权保留的早期产物、承诺、有效授权及历史记录，可能会影响后续决策。 例如，第 50 天收到的请求，可能需要结合第 3 天达成的协议、第 20 天更新的授权以及第 45 天出现的争议来处理。

sents.en: A longitudinal service record establishes whether matters are handled correctly across tasks and time.
sents.zh: 纵向服务记录用于确认各项事务是否在不同任务和不同时间上得到正确处理。

sents.en: For example, a request received on day 50 may need to be handled in light of an agreement made on day 3, an authorization updated on day 20, and a dispute arising on day 45.
sents.zh: 例如，第 50 天收到的请求，可能需要结合第 3 天达成的协议、第 20 天更新的授权以及第 45 天出现的争议来处理。

paragraphs.en: These three kinds of records let evaluators ask whether a service can be created, whether individual tasks are completed well, and whether the working relationship holds up over time. Creation records retain successful and failed attempts; episode records capture delivery and acceptance; longitudinal records show how earlier work and obligations affect later actions. All three inform the platform-level assessment. Failed creation or publication attempts remain in the end-to-end results, so the evaluation does not consider only agents that reached operation successfully.
paragraphs.zh: 这三类记录让评估者能够追问：一项服务能否被创建、单个任务是否完成得好，以及协作关系能否长期维持。 创建记录保留成功与失败的尝试；过程记录捕捉交付与验收；纵向记录展示早期的工作与义务如何影响后续行动。 这三者共同为平台层面的评估提供依据。 失败的创建或发布尝试仍保留在端到端结果中，因此评估不会只考虑那些成功进入运行阶段的智能体。

paragraphs.en: This section sets out the checks, scoring criteria, and review requirements for the eight dimensions. The question throughout is whether a platform enables different individuals to create external service agents and provide ongoing service to clients. The technical inventory records the methods and resources used to help explain the results; feature counts do not determine scores.

paragraphs.en: Before running a test, evaluators must decide what evidence will show that the task is complete. Following the contract-first task decomposition proposed in Intelligent AI Delegation [ 11 ] , they define the required deliverables and acceptance procedures, then break broad requirements into checks that can be judged separately. For a research report, these might cover the scope of the evidence, reproducibility of calculations, support for claims, and whether the analysis answers the client’s question. Software can check fields and calculations; qualified independent reviewers assess professional judgment. The complete artifact must still be judged against the original task. Passing a few convenient checks cannot substitute for meeting the overall objective.
paragraphs.zh: 在运行测试之前，评估者必须先决定什么样的证据能够表明任务已经完成。 按照《Intelligent AI Delegation》[11]提出的契约优先任务分解方法，他们先定义所需的交付物和验收流程，再把宽泛的需求拆解为可以单独评判的检查项。 对于一份研究报告，这些检查项可能涵盖证据的范围、计算的可复现性、对论断的支持程度，以及分析是否回答了客户的问题。 软件可以检查字段和计算；专业判断则由合格的独立评审者来评估。 最终的完整成果仍须对照原始任务来评判。 通过几项方便的检查并不能替代达成总体目标。

paragraphs.en: An acceptance contract must specify what counts as acceptable, who verifies it, what evidence they use, and how exceptions are handled. Table 6-1 lists the minimum elements shared across dimensions. The evaluator maintains contracts, reference answers, and acceptance procedures; the evaluated system submits artifacts and necessary execution records. Its claim of completion requires independent support. For open-ended work requiring human review, the review target, rubric, reviewer qualifications, disagreement resolution, and budget must be specified in advance. If further decomposition cannot make a requirement reliably assessable, a suitable expert review should be arranged, the scope negotiated before execution, or the result left pending acceptance. Requirements should not be relaxed after the fact.
paragraphs.zh: 验收契约必须明确规定什么算作合格、由谁进行验证、使用什么证据，以及如何处理例外情况。 表 6-1 列出了各维度共有的最低要素。 评估方维护契约、参考答案和验收流程；被评估系统提交产物和必要的执行记录。 其完成声明需要独立支撑。 对于需要人工评审的开放性工作，必须在事先明确评审对象、评分标准、评审人资质、分歧解决方式以及预算。 如果进一步分解仍无法使某项需求得到可靠评估，则应安排合适的专家评审、在执行前协商范围，或将结果留待验收。 需求不应在事后放宽。

paragraphs.en: Report diagnostic scores, acceptance decisions, and the sufficiency of the evidence separately. Diagnostic scores summarize predefined checks using fixed weights. A delivery is accepted only when it meets every mandatory condition and reaches the overall score threshold. If evidence is missing, keep the predefined denominator and withhold a complete score; do not rescale a few verified successes into a perfect score. Conversely, confirmed failure of a mandatory condition is enough to reject the delivery, even while other checks remain unresolved. A required file or field missing from the sealed submission means the delivery is incomplete. A relevant record that the evaluator failed to collect means there is insufficient evidence. Suspected tampering, contradictory timestamps, and counts outside permitted ranges should be flagged and reviewed as evidence anomalies before drawing conclusions about platform capability.
paragraphs.zh: 分别报告诊断评分、接受决定以及证据的充分性。 诊断评分使用固定权重对预先定义的检查项进行汇总。 只有当交付满足每一项强制条件并达到总体评分阈值时，才会被接受。 如果证据缺失，应保留预先定义的分母并暂不给出完整评分；不要把少数已验证的成功重新换算成满分。 反之，某项强制条件被确认失败即足以拒绝交付，即使其他检查仍未得出结论。 封存提交中缺少必需的文件或字段，意味着交付不完整。 评估者未能收集到相关记录，意味着证据不充分。 疑似篡改、相互矛盾的时间戳以及超出许可范围的计数，应被标记出来，并在对平台能力下结论之前作为证据异常加以审查。

paragraphs.en: Ease of creation assesses whether people with different backgrounds can independently set up and manage a working external service agent within specified time and assistance limits. Testing begins when they enter the creation process and covers identity binding, service scope, professional requirements, permissions, publication, pending approvals, rule changes, and service termination. Saving a page or submitting a configuration does not demonstrate successful creation. The service must be accessible to external clients, and independent tests must show that its key settings affect the agent’s behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 创建难易度评估不同背景的人员能否在规定的时间和辅助限度内独立搭建并管理一个可正常工作的对外服务智能体。 测试从他们进入创建流程时开始，涵盖身份绑定、服务范围、专业要求、权限、发布、待审核事项、规则变更以及服务终止。 保存页面或提交配置并不能证明创建成功。 该服务必须可供外部客户端访问，并且独立测试必须表明其关键设置会影响智能体的行为。

paragraphs.en: Creation tests record the outcome and the help required, so that work done by experts or experienced platform users is not mistaken for ease of use by ordinary users. The unit of observation is one person’s attempt to create a service. Required actions, time limits, permitted assistance, and error-recovery tasks are defined in advance. Results distinguish unassisted completion, completion with permitted help, takeover by someone else, and failure. Failed creation and publication attempts remain in the end-to-end statistics. Scripts can verify that a function exists or an interaction path works. Only tests with real creators can show whether people understand the process and can detect and correct configuration errors. A successful script alone does not establish ease of use.
paragraphs.zh: 创建测试记录结果以及所需的帮助，以免专家或有经验的平台用户所完成的工作被误认为是普通用户的易用性。 观察单位是一个人创建服务的一次尝试。 所需操作、时限、允许的协助以及错误恢复任务均提前定义。 结果区分独立完成、在允许的协助下完成、由他人接手以及失败。 失败的创建与发布尝试仍计入端到端统计。 脚本可以验证某个功能是否存在或某条交互路径是否可行。 只有使用真实创建者的测试才能表明人们是否理解该流程，以及能否发现并纠正配置错误。 仅凭一个成功的脚本并不能证明易用性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 illustrates how personal capabilities enter actual service. Identity and authorization establish representation; preferences and professional methods guide handling; knowledge bases supply evidence; skill libraries organize reusable methods; and tool connections enable authorized actions. Skills and MCP are examples of implementation options, not a required architecture. Evaluation asks whether configurations affect real delivery while preserving separation among clients’ materials.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 展示了个人能力如何进入实际服务。 身份与授权确立代表关系；偏好与专业方法指导处理方式；知识库提供证据；技能库组织可复用的方法；工具连接实现经授权的操作。 技能和 MCP 是实现方式的一些示例，并非必需的架构。 评估关注的是这些配置是否影响实际交付，同时保持客户材料之间的隔离。

paragraphs.en: Service discovery and matching assesses whether clients can find an appropriate personal external service agent and successfully initiate a service engagement. A client may start with a task and constraints on expertise, budget, deadline, and human involvement, or may seek a particular person or a provider with a specific professional background. Platforms should make service scope, delivery arrangements, pricing, and the principal’s involvement understandable so that clients can make informed choices.
paragraphs.zh: 服务发现与匹配评估客户是否能够找到合适的个人外部服务智能体，并成功发起服务合作。 客户可能从一项任务以及关于专业技能、预算、截止期限和人类参与程度的约束条件出发，也可能寻求特定的人或具有特定专业背景的服务提供者。 平台应使服务范围、交付安排、定价以及委托人的参与方式清晰易懂，以便客户能够做出知情选择。

sents.en: Service discovery and matching assesses whether clients can find an appropriate personal external service agent and successfully initiate a service engagement.
sents.zh: 服务发现与匹配评估客户是否能够找到合适的个人外部服务智能体，并成功发起服务合作。

sents.en: A client may start with a task and constraints on expertise, budget, deadline, and human involvement, or may seek a particular person or a provider with a specific professional background.
sents.zh: 客户可能从一项任务以及关于专业技能、预算、截止期限和人类参与程度的约束条件出发，也可能寻求特定的人或具有特定专业背景的服务提供者。

sents.en: Platforms should make service scope, delivery arrangements, pricing, and the principal’s involvement understandable so that clients can make informed choices.
sents.zh: 平台应使服务范围、交付安排、定价以及委托人的参与方式清晰易懂，以便客户能够做出知情选择。

paragraphs.en: Tests should cover clients searching by task as well as by a person’s identity or professional background. Scenarios can offer several suitable services, a mix of suitable and unsuitable services, or no suitable service. Evaluators check whether the platform presents relevant options, explains key limitations, and lets the client commission the work. Measures may include the rate at which clients find suitable candidates, the rate at which they choose unsuitable services, the time needed to choose, and the rate of successful engagement initiation. Where several choices are reasonable, the test should not require one uniquely correct selection.
paragraphs.zh: 测试应涵盖客户按任务搜索，以及按个人身份或专业背景搜索的情况。 场景可以提供若干合适的服务、合适与不合适服务的组合，或不提供任何合适的服务。 评估者检查平台是否呈现相关选项、解释关键限制，并允许客户委托该工作。 衡量指标可包括：客户找到合适候选者的比率、选择不合适服务的比率、做出选择所需的时间，以及成功发起委托的比率。 在存在多个合理选择的情况下，测试不应要求只有一个唯一正确的选择。

sents.en: Tests should cover clients searching by task as well as by a person’s identity or professional background.
sents.zh: 测试应涵盖客户按任务搜索，以及按个人身份或专业背景搜索的情况。

sents.en: Scenarios can offer several suitable services, a mix of suitable and unsuitable services, or no suitable service.

sents.zh: 衡量指标可包括：客户找到合适候选者的比率、选择不合适服务的比率、做出选择所需的时间，以及成功发起委托的比率。

sents.en: Where several choices are reasonable, the test should not require one uniquely correct selection.
sents.zh: 在存在多个合理选择的情况下，测试不应要求只有一个唯一正确的选择。

paragraphs.en: During discovery, evaluators should verify both who authorized the agent and what the service promises. Platforms should state whether the individual has authorized the agent, provide evidence for professional experience relevant to the client’s choice, and specify which work the individual will review. A verified identity is not proof of competence. For repeat requests, tests should also check whether the client or personal assistant can find the same service again, understand its current scope and any changes, and initiate another task within the authorization granted. Human clients and demand-side agents may use different interfaces, but both need enough information to understand and choose the service.
paragraphs.zh: 在探索阶段，评估者应同时核实是谁授权了该智能体，以及该服务承诺了什么。 平台应说明个人是否已授权该智能体，提供与客户选择相关的专业经验证据，并明确该个人将审核哪些工作。 经过验证的身份并不能证明能力。 对于重复请求，测试还应检查客户或个人助理能否再次找到同一服务，理解其当前范围及任何变更，并在已授予的授权范围内发起另一项任务。 人类客户和需求方智能体可能使用不同的界面，但两者都需要足够的信息来理解并选择该服务。

sents.en: During discovery, evaluators should verify both who authorized the agent and what the service promises.
sents.zh: 在探索阶段，评估者应同时核实是谁授权了该智能体，以及该服务承诺了什么。

sents.en: Platforms should state whether the individual has authorized the agent, provide evidence for professional experience relevant to the client’s choice, and specify which work the individual will review.
sents.zh: 平台应说明个人是否已授权该智能体，提供与客户选择相关的专业经验证据，并明确该个人将审核哪些工作。

sents.en: A verified identity is not proof of competence.
sents.zh: 经过验证的身份并不能证明能力。

sents.en: For repeat requests, tests should also check whether the client or personal assistant can find the same service again, understand its current scope and any changes, and initiate another task within the authorization granted.
sents.zh: 对于重复请求，测试还应检查客户或个人助理能否再次找到同一服务，理解其当前范围及任何变更，并在已授予的授权范围内发起另一项任务。

sents.en: Human clients and demand-side agents may use different interfaces, but both need enough information to understand and choose the service.
sents.zh: 人类客户和需求方智能体可能使用不同的界面，但两者都需要足够的信息来理解并选择该服务。

paragraphs.en: Delivery quality assesses whether the artifacts actually received by the client meet previously confirmed task requirements and are usable in practice. Acceptance distinguishes mandatory conditions from ordinary preferences and checks content, usability, version, recipient, and deadline. A confirmed failure of any mandatory condition prevents overall acceptance; preferences are assessed with a predefined rubric. Revisions must distinguish repairs to original defects from new client requirements. Initial and revised deliveries are retained separately: expanded scope must not be recorded as an original defect, and a successful revision must not erase problems in the first delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 交付质量评估客户实际收到的交付物是否满足先前确认的任务要求，并在实践中可用。 验收将强制性条件与一般偏好区分开来，并检查内容、可用性、版本、接收人和截止期限。 任何强制性条件被确认不通过都会阻止整体验收；偏好则按照预定义的评分标准进行评估。 修订必须区分对原始缺陷的修复与客户新提出的需求。 初次交付与修订后的交付分别保留：扩大的范围不得被记录为原始缺陷，一次成功的修订也不得抹去首次交付中存在的问题。

paragraphs.en: Complex tasks should be broken into subtasks whose completion can be verified independently, while the final result is still assessed as a whole. Consider a study of the global new-energy vehicle market. A report alone is not proof of completion: the research subject, evidence cutoff, source scope, and client’s questions must first be clear. The work might produce a policy inventory, company and product tables, a comparison of forecasts, and a synthesis. Policy entries need verified names, dates, issuing authorities, and sources. Product prices must identify the model, configuration, and date. Where a price has not been published, that absence must be stated. Forecasts need their year, units, coverage, and source, and must be distinguished from observed statistics. Software can check fields, calculations, and whether entries correspond correctly. Independent review must determine whether the sources support the conclusions, statistical definitions are consistent, and the synthesis answers the client’s questions. Working links, numerous citations, and filled-in tables do not establish the quality of the study as a whole.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂任务应分解为可独立验证完成情况的子任务，同时最终结果仍需作为整体加以评估。 以对全球新能源汽车市场的研究为例。 仅有一份报告并不能证明任务完成：必须先明确研究主题、证据截止时间、来源范围以及客户的问题。 这项工作可能产出的成果包括政策清单、公司与产品表格、预测对比以及综合分析。 政策条目需要经过核实的名称、日期、发布机构和来源。 产品价格必须标明车型、配置和日期。 如果某项价格尚未公布，必须明确说明这一情况。 预测需要标注年份、单位、覆盖范围和来源，并且必须与观测统计数据区分开来。 软件可以检查字段、计算，以及各条目是否正确对应。 独立审查必须判断来源是否支持结论、统计定义是否一致，以及综合分析是否回答了客户的问题。 链接有效、引用众多、表格填写完整，并不能确立研究整体的质量。

paragraphs.en: Code should be evaluated in an independent test environment that the system under evaluation cannot modify. Documents, presentations, and videos require separate checks of file usability and content quality. Clear requirements need not be reconfirmed repeatedly, and execution paths need not be prescribed. Work that invokes other software, models, or collaborating agents remains subject to the same acceptance standard.
paragraphs.zh: 代码应在被评估系统无法修改的独立测试环境中进行评估。 文档、演示文稿和视频需要对文件可用性和内容质量分别进行检查。 明确的需求无需反复确认，执行路径也无需加以规定。 涉及其他软件、模型或协作智能体的工作仍适用同样的验收标准。

paragraphs.en: Multi-artifact deliveries require checks of both individual components and consistency across them, as well as confirmation that acceptance evidence corresponds to the actual submission. Numbers in a report and presentation should agree; documentation should match the submitted source-code version; receipts should identify the actual files and recipient; and a delivery package must not contain another client’s materials. Human review also requires explicit criteria. A research report can be checked separately for question coverage, source support, and consistency of statistical definitions rather than receiving only a holistic impression. A confirmed failure of any mandatory component cannot be offset by higher scores elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 多成果物交付需要既检查各组成部分本身，也检查它们之间的一致性，还需确认验收证据与实际提交内容相符。 报告中的数字与演示文稿应当一致；文档应与提交的源代码版本相匹配；收据应标明实际文件和接收方；交付包中不得包含其他客户的材料。 人工审查同样需要明确的标准。 研究报告可以分别核查问题覆盖度、来源支撑以及统计定义的一致性，而不是只获得一个整体印象。 任何强制性组成部分经确认不合格，都无法用其他方面的高分来抵消。

paragraphs.en: Tasks that cannot be fully checked by software require independent human review. A research report, for example, needs verification of data and citations as well as expert assessment of its reasoning and conclusions. Reviewers should use predefined criteria and retain decisions and supporting evidence for later inspection. Substantial disagreement requires further review. A task awaiting mandatory review must not be marked as accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 无法由软件完全检查的任务需要由人工进行独立审查。 例如，一份研究报告不仅需要核对数据和引用，还需要专家对其推理和结论进行评估。 审查者应使用预先定义的标准，并保留决定及其支持证据以供日后查验。 若存在重大分歧，则需要进一步审查。 等待强制审查的任务不得被标记为已接受。

paragraphs.en: Expertise inheritance assesses whether platform configuration and continued development enable an agent to apply a particular individual’s knowledge, experience, judgment, and working standards in real service. This expertise can be embodied in proprietary datasets and knowledge bases, reusable skills and standard operating procedures, code and tools developed by the individual, or models trained or adapted using the individual’s datasets. These models may be adapted general-purpose language models, smaller task-specific models, or specialized recognition models. Interfaces such as MCP connect the tools and models to the agent’s workflow. Resources may be public or kept in an environment controlled by the individual, where authorized calls allow their use without disclosing the full data, code, or model.
paragraphs.zh: 专长继承评估平台配置与持续开发能否使智能体在真实服务中应用某个特定个人的知识、经验、判断与工作标准。 这种专长可以体现在专有数据集与知识库、可复用的技能与标准操作流程、由该个人开发的代码与工具，或使用该个人数据集训练或适配的模型之中。 这些模型可以是经过适配的通用语言模型、更小的任务专用模型，或专门化的识别模型。 MCP 等接口将工具与模型连接到智能体的工作流中。 资源可以是公开的，也可以保存在由该个人控制的环境中，在授权调用下即可使用，而无需披露完整的数据、代码或模型。

paragraphs.en: Consider a horticultural expert who spends years collecting images of pests and diseases affecting a particular flower species, along with diagnostic records and treatment outcomes. A specialist model trained on that unpublished dataset, used together with the expert’s diagnostic workflow and cultivation knowledge, could extend that expertise to more clients. Evaluation must show that these resources make a verifiable contribution to relevant tasks, including whether they meet specific service needs better than a general-purpose model using only public materials.
paragraphs.zh: 设想一位园艺专家，他花费多年时间收集某种花卉的病虫害图像，以及诊断记录和治疗结果。 在该未公开数据集上训练的专用模型，若与该专家的诊断流程和栽培知识结合使用，可以将这份专业知识扩展给更多客户。 评估必须表明这些资源对相关任务做出了可验证的贡献，包括它们是否比仅使用公开材料的通用模型更好地满足特定服务需求。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation must distinguish persona-based role-play from the use of an individual’s professional expertise. Some role-play services assign a name, biography, interests, and speaking style to portray a historical or fictional character, such as the poet Li Bai. A recognizable persona does not by itself transfer expertise. Without relevant knowledge, methods, and tools, performance on practical tasks still depends largely on the underlying general-purpose model. A personal external service agent is closer to an apprentice who learns from the person it represents: the individual’s materials, cases, methods, code, and models help it solve relevant professional problems. Tests should ask whether these resources change how the agent works and what it delivers.
paragraphs.zh: 评估必须区分基于人设的角色扮演与对个人专业知识的运用。 一些角色扮演服务会为一个历史人物或虚构角色指定姓名、生平、兴趣爱好和说话风格，例如诗人李白。 一个可辨认的人设本身并不会带来专业能力。 缺乏相关的知识、方法和工具时，在实际任务上的表现仍在很大程度上取决于底层的通用模型。 个人对外服务智能体更像一个向其所代表的人学习的学徒：个人的材料、案例、方法、代码和模型帮助它解决相关的专业问题。 测试应当探究这些资源是否改变了智能体的工作方式及其交付成果。

paragraphs.en: With the foundation model, access to public tools, and resource conditions kept comparable, configurations with and without personal resources can be tested on new tasks. The checks ask whether those resources help the agent identify key issues, choose appropriate methods, reduce professional errors, or better meet requirements. Persona and style can make a service recognizable, but expertise inheritance requires evidence from the work itself.

sents.zh: 这些检验考察的是，这些资源是否有助于智能体识别关键问题、选择合适的方法、减少专业错误，或更好地满足要求。

sents.en: Persona and style can make a service recognizable, but expertise inheritance requires evidence from the work itself.
sents.zh: 人设与风格可以让一项服务具有辨识度，但专业能力的传承需要来自工作本身的证据。

paragraphs.en: Expertise inheritance tests a fixed system version: can the agent correctly access and apply the personal resources already available to it on independent tasks? The model, personal resources, and configuration are held constant. Learning and improvement tests a different question: do updates based on authorized service experience produce additional benefits attributable to that experience? It therefore compares versions before and after the update. The two dimensions report existing capability and experience-driven change separately. Each gain is scored only in its assigned dimension, and any additional human help is recorded separately.
paragraphs.zh: 专长继承测试的是固定版本的系统：智能体能否在独立任务中正确访问并运用其已有的个人资源？ 模型、个人资源和配置保持不变。 学习与提升测试的是另一个问题：基于经授权的服务经验的更新是否能产生可归因于该经验的额外收益？ 因此，它会对比更新前后的版本。 这两个维度分别报告既有能力与由经验驱动的变化。 每项收益只在其所属维度中计分，任何额外的人工帮助则单独记录。

paragraphs.en: Service continuity assesses whether an agent correctly carries existing requirements, artifacts, commitments, and unfinished work into later service. Saving a history is not enough: the agent must use relevant history when deciding what to do next. Each ongoing matter should be linked to its principal, client, artifact version, applicable requirements, and current status. When the agent handles overlapping tasks or multiple clients, it must keep the relevant materials, versions, and commitments separate.
paragraphs.zh: 服务连续性评估智能体是否将既有需求、产物、承诺和未完成的工作正确地延续到后续服务中。 仅保存历史是不够的：智能体在决定下一步做什么时必须使用相关的历史记录。 每个正在进行的事项都应与其委托人、客户、产物版本、适用需求和当前状态相关联。 当智能体处理相互重叠的任务或多个客户时，它必须将相关的材料、版本和承诺保持分离。

sents.en: Service continuity assesses whether an agent correctly carries existing requirements, artifacts, commitments, and unfinished work into later service.
sents.zh: 服务连续性评估智能体是否将既有需求、产物、承诺和未完成的工作正确地延续到后续服务中。

sents.en: Saving a history is not enough: the agent must use relevant history when deciding what to do next.
sents.zh: 仅保存历史是不够的：智能体在决定下一步做什么时必须使用相关的历史记录。

sents.en: Each ongoing matter should be linked to its principal, client, artifact version, applicable requirements, and current status.
sents.zh: 每个正在进行的事项都应与其委托人、客户、产物版本、适用需求和当前状态相关联。

sents.en: When the agent handles overlapping tasks or multiple clients, it must keep the relevant materials, versions, and commitments separate.
sents.zh: 当智能体处理相互重叠的任务或多个客户时，它必须将相关的材料、版本和承诺保持分离。

paragraphs.en: Continuity is judged by what the agent does next, rather than by its ability to recount the past. New authorization, rules, or client requirements may change subsequent actions, but do not automatically cancel existing commitments or unfinished work. If the original approach is no longer available, evaluation should check whether the agent recognizes the change, pursues permitted alternatives, contacts someone authorized to approve a modification, and keeps track of the matter. Records must distinguish obligations that are not yet due, overdue obligations, changes accepted by the client, and changes that have only been proposed. Proposing a solution does not fulfill an obligation.
paragraphs.zh: 连续性依据智能体接下来做什么来判断，而不是依据它复述过去的能力。 新的授权、规则或客户要求可能会改变后续行动，但不会自动取消现有的承诺或未完成的工作。 如果原来的方法不再可用，评估应检查智能体是否识别到这一变化、是否寻求允许的替代方案、是否联系有权限批准修改的人员，以及是否持续跟进该事项。 记录必须区分尚未到期的义务、已逾期的义务、客户已接受的变更，以及仅被提议的变更。 提出解决方案并不等于履行了义务。

paragraphs.en: Continuity also includes necessary proactive follow-up on existing services within the agent’s authorization. When an external change affects an artifact or commitment, the agent should determine its relevance and, where appropriate, update the artifact, notify the client, or advance outstanding work. Unrelated changes should not cause repeated interruptions. Repeated reminders about one event must not count as multiple successes. The value of follow-up should be assessed from its actual consequences rather than the number of notifications sent.
paragraphs.zh: 延续性还包括在智能体授权范围内对现有服务进行必要的主动跟进。 当外部变化影响某个交付物或承诺时，智能体应判断其相关性，并在适当时更新交付物、通知客户或推进未完成的工作。 无关的变化不应造成反复打扰。 针对同一事件的重复提醒不得计为多次成功。 跟进的价值应根据其实际产生的后果来评估，而不是根据发送通知的数量。

sents.en: Continuity also includes necessary proactive follow-up on existing services within the agent’s authorization.
sents.zh: 延续性还包括在智能体授权范围内对现有服务进行必要的主动跟进。

sents.en: When an external change affects an artifact or commitment, the agent should determine its relevance and, where appropriate, update the artifact, notify the client, or advance outstanding work.

sents.en: Unrelated changes should not cause repeated interruptions.
sents.zh: 无关的变化不应造成反复打扰。

sents.en: Repeated reminders about one event must not count as multiple successes.
sents.zh: 针对同一事件的重复提醒不得计为多次成功。

sents.en: The value of follow-up should be assessed from its actual consequences rather than the number of notifications sent.
sents.zh: 跟进的价值应根据其实际产生的后果来评估，而不是根据发送通知的数量。

paragraphs.en: Learning and improvement assesses whether service experience gives an agent reusable capabilities that improve its performance on new tasks. Expertise inheritance tests a fixed version’s use of accumulated personal resources; this dimension tests the additional benefits of updates based on authorized service experience. That experience may include client feedback, revision requests, human corrections, task outcomes, verifier results, environmental changes, and execution records. After a service episode, the system may remain unchanged or update its memory, knowledge, rules, skills, workflows, or model parameters. Evaluation must compare the versions on independent tasks to establish what changed.
paragraphs.zh: 学习与改进评估服务体验是否能为智能体提供可复用的能力，从而提升其在新技术任务上的表现。 专长继承测试的是固定版本对累积个人资源的使用；而本维度测试的是基于经授权的服务体验进行更新所带来的额外收益。 这些体验可能包括客户反馈、修改请求、人工纠正、任务结果、验证器结果、环境变化以及执行记录。 在一次服务过程结束后，系统可能保持不变，也可能更新其记忆、知识、规则、技能、工作流或模型参数。 评估必须在相互独立的任务上对各个版本进行比较，以确定究竟发生了什么变化。

paragraphs.en: Learning may change an agent’s memory, knowledge, rules, skills, workflows, or model parameters. Experience can be stored in long-term memory or a knowledge base for later retrieval, or used to revise prompts, rules, checklists, and decision strategies. Repeated successful sequences of actions can become callable skills or programs. Changes to task order, tool combinations, and points of human involvement can improve workflows. More stable experience that transfers across tasks may be incorporated into model parameters through fine-tuning, preference learning, or reinforcement learning. Some systems may also use execution history to improve how they form memories, select skills, or organize workflows. Evaluation should examine these actual changes, rather than simply check whether the platform has a training interface.
paragraphs.zh: 学习可能会改变智能体的记忆、知识、规则、技能、工作流或模型参数。 经验可以存储在长期记忆或知识库中以便日后检索，也可以用于修订提示词、规则、检查清单和决策策略。 反复成功的动作序列可以成为可调用的技能或程序。 调整任务顺序、工具组合以及人类参与的环节可以改进工作流。 更稳定且可跨任务迁移的经验，可以通过微调、偏好学习或强化学习融入模型参数。 一些系统还可能利用执行历史来改进其形成记忆、选择技能或组织工作流的方式。 评估应当考察这些实际发生的改变，而不是简单地检查平台是否具有训练接口。

paragraphs.en: Parametric memory modules offer one way to support learning, but evaluation must account for their access requirements and resource costs. DFM, for example, freezes the foundation model, trains added modules, and integrates memory into intermediate model layers [ 22 ] . 1 1 1 The reported DFM efficiency comparison uses approximately 0.75B added parameters. On 16 A800 GPUs, MLP Memory and DFM take about 64 and 24 training hours, respectively, excluding target construction and evaluation. Offline retrieval query counts and returned-entry counts are 1/32 and 1/2048 of the comparison method’s counts. These figures describe training or retrieval work under a particular configuration, not proportional reductions in total service cost or overall compute. See Section 4.4 and Appendix D of [ 22 ] . This method requires access to the model’s internals, so it cannot be applied directly when a model is available only through an inference API. For personal services, evaluation must also check permission to use the training materials, the module version, gains on independent test tasks, retention of existing capabilities, update costs, and what happens when permission is withdrawn. Gains from adapting a model to a static corpus must be tested separately from gains due to feedback from ongoing service.
paragraphs.zh: 参数化记忆模块为支持学习提供了一种途径，但评估必须考虑其访问需求和资源成本。 例如，DFM 冻结基础模型，训练新增模块，并将记忆整合到模型的中间层 [ 22 ] 。1 1 1 所报告的 DFM 效率对比使用了约 0.75B 的新增参数。 在 16 块 A800 GPU 上，MLP Memory 和 DFM 分别需要约 64 和 24 小时的训练时间，不含目标构建与评估。 离线检索的查询次数和返回条目数分别为对比方法的 1/32 和 1/2048。 这些数字描述的是特定配置下的训练或检索工作量，并非总服务成本或总体计算量按比例的下降。 参见 [ 22 ] 的第 4.4 节和附录 D。 该方法需要访问模型内部，因此当模型仅能通过推理 API 使用时，无法直接应用。 对于个人服务，评估还必须检查使用训练材料的许可、模块版本、在独立测试任务上的收益、对既有能力的保留、更新成本，以及许可被撤回时会发生什么。 将模型适配到静态语料库所带来的收益，必须与来自持续服务反馈的收益分开测试。

paragraphs.en: The system must also decide what to retain and where to retain it. A client’s current budget, a project’s software version, or a contact’s temporary permission may change quickly; these facts are better kept as service state or memory that can be queried and updated. More stable practices, such as aligning statistical definitions before market research or running regression tests after a code change, may become reusable rules, skills, or workflows. Capabilities repeatedly validated across many tasks and shown to transfer well may eventually be incorporated into model parameters through training. Systems can also absorb incorrect feedback, outdated knowledge, and incidental experience. Learning therefore requires correction, replacement, consolidation, and forgetting as well as the addition of information. Over time, an agent should make better choices about what to retain, how to organize it, and when to use it.
paragraphs.zh: 系统还必须决定保留什么以及在哪里保留。 客户的当前预算、项目的软件版本或联系人的临时权限可能快速变化；这类事实更适合保存为可查询、可更新的服务状态或记忆。 更稳定的实践，例如在市场调研之前对齐统计口径，或在代码变更之后运行回归测试，则可能沉淀为可复用的规则、技能或工作流。 在众多任务中被反复验证且表现出良好迁移能力的技能，最终可能通过训练被融入模型参数。 系统同样可能吸收错误的反馈、过时的知识和偶然的经验。 因此，学习不仅需要增加信息，还需要纠错、替换、巩固和遗忘。 随着时间推移，智能体应当在保留什么、如何组织以及何时使用方面做出更好的选择。

paragraphs.en: DelegateEval distinguishes storage, adaptation, and learning. Storage records a fact, such as a client’s use of Python 3.10. Adaptation uses that fact to adjust behavior, such as selecting Python 3.10 for the client’s project. Learning turns experience into a reusable method that improves future work: after repeated compatibility-related revisions, for example, an agent develops a version-checking procedure that reduces similar errors in new clients’ projects. Service continuity primarily tests whether storage and adaptation allow earlier matters to be handled correctly. Learning and improvement requires further evidence that past experience improves the agent’s ability to solve new problems; retaining more information alone is insufficient.
paragraphs.zh: DelegateEval 区分了存储、适应和学习。 存储记录一个事实，例如客户端使用 Python 3.10。 适应利用该事实调整行为，例如为客户端的项目选择 Python 3.10。 学习将经验转化为可复用的方法，从而改进未来的工作：例如，在经历多次与兼容性相关的修订后，智能体会形成一套版本检查流程，以减少在新客户端项目中出现类似错误。 服务连续性主要检验存储和适应能否让先前的事项得到正确处理。 学习与改进还需要进一步的证据，证明过去的经验能提升智能体解决新问题的能力；仅仅保留更多信息是不够的。

paragraphs.en: To test learning, compare versions before and after an update on independent tasks. Fix the initial version, authorized experience, update budget, primary metrics, and test tasks in advance. The procedure is to run a service episode, evaluate it independently, return the experience that the system is authorized to use, perform the update, and test the new version on new tasks. Both versions should complete the same held-out and transfer tasks under comparable conditions, with checks for retention of existing capabilities. Separate genuinely unseen tasks from training and feedback examples, close paraphrases, and task branches that share history, so that memorization or overfitting is not counted as learning. A service may improve by relying on more human work, but the benefits of that additional labor must not be attributed to system learning.
paragraphs.zh: 为检验学习效果，应在相互独立的任务上对比更新前后的版本。 应提前固定初始版本、授权经验、更新预算、主要指标和测试任务。 具体流程是：运行一个服务回合（episode），对其进行独立评估，返回系统被授权使用的经验，执行更新，然后在新任务上测试新版本。 两个版本应在可比条件下完成相同的留出任务和迁移任务，并检查是否保留了既有能力。 应将真正未见过的任务与训练和反馈样例、近似改写，以及共享历史记录的任务分支区分开来，以免把记忆或过拟合算作学习。 一个服务可能通过依赖更多的人工工作而改进，但这类额外劳动带来的收益不得归因于系统学习。

paragraphs.en: Learning results should report transfer, retention, forgetting, negative transfer, risk, and cost alongside improvement. An update may help the current task while damaging an earlier capability, help within one domain while causing errors elsewhere, or improve quality at substantial human-curation and compute cost. Incorrect or low-quality feedback should be tested explicitly to establish whether the agent absorbs it uncritically. A complete learning result should establish whether new-task performance improved, whether the gain transfers, whether previous capabilities were retained, whether new risks emerged, and what update and human costs were incurred.
paragraphs.zh: 学习结果除了报告提升之外，还应报告迁移、保留、遗忘、负迁移、风险和成本。 一次更新可能在帮助当前任务的同时损害较早的能力，可能在一个领域内有所帮助却在其他领域造成错误，也可能在大幅提高质量的同时带来高昂的人工策展和计算成本。 应当对错误或低质量的反馈进行显式测试，以确定智能体是否会不加批判地吸收它们。 一份完整的学习结果应当确定：新任务的表现是否提升，增益是否可迁移，先前的能力是否得到保留，是否出现了新的风险，以及付出了哪些更新成本和人力成本。

paragraphs.en: A valid experiment may show no improvement or even a decline. If the source of feedback, the relationship between system versions, the update process, and the test tasks can all be verified, report no observed improvement when performance is unchanged, and degradation or negative transfer when it falls. A claim of reusable learning requires meeting predefined improvement criteria on independent test tasks while satisfying the required retention and safety conditions. If test data have leaked, versions cannot be linked reliably, experience has been used without permission, or human and system contributions cannot be separated, the result cannot be attributed to system learning.
paragraphs.zh: 一个有效的实验可能显示没有改进，甚至出现下降。 如果反馈来源、系统版本之间的关系、更新过程和测试任务都能得到验证，则在性能不变时应报告未观察到改进，在性能下降时应报告退化或负迁移。 声称存在可复用的学习，需要在独立测试任务上达到预定义的改进标准，同时满足所需的保持和安全条件。 如果测试数据已泄露、版本无法可靠关联、经验在未经许可的情况下被使用，或人类与系统的贡献无法区分，则该结果不能归因于系统学习。

paragraphs.en: The practical question is whether experience from earlier service improves later service. An agent should build on authorized corrections, methods, and experience from meeting client commitments, retaining them in forms suited to later use. When it encounters new clients, projects, and environments, this experience should help it avoid recurring errors, use better methods, and require less repeated intervention from the principal. The presence of memory, training, or update interfaces does not by itself demonstrate such improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 实际问题在于，早期服务的经验能否改进后续服务。 智能体应当建立在授权的纠正、方法以及履行客户承诺过程中获得的经验之上，并以适合后续使用的形式加以保留。 当它遇到新的客户、项目和环境时，这些经验应当帮助它避免重复犯错、采用更好的方法，并减少委托人的重复干预。 拥有记忆、训练或更新接口本身并不足以证明存在这样的改进。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 separates two evidence paths: continuity concerns how earlier matters are carried forward; learning concerns whether experience improves performance on independent test tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 区分了两条证据路径：连续性关注先前的任务如何被延续推进；学习性关注经验是否能提升在独立测试任务上的表现。

paragraphs.en: Reliability and governance assesses whether a platform follows the applicable rules for identity, authorization, data use, human involvement, and failure handling as it provides services. Tests should check whether permissions are clear, actual actions comply with them, and valid rule changes take effect promptly. The existence of permission settings is not enough. Each important authorization should specify who grants it, what it applies to, the resource and version involved, the permitted operations, and when it takes effect. A contact’s identity, right to receive materials, and authority to approve changes for a client must be checked separately. A genuine identity, a familiar relationship, or access to some information does not establish any further permission.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠性与治理评估平台在提供服务的过程中，是否在身份、授权、数据使用、人员介入和故障处理方面遵循适用的规则。 测试应检查权限是否清晰、实际操作是否符合权限，以及有效的规则变更是否及时生效。 仅仅存在权限设置是不够的。 每项重要授权都应明确由谁授予、适用于什么、涉及哪些资源及版本、允许哪些操作，以及何时生效。 联系人的身份、接收资料的权利以及为客户批准变更的权限必须分别核验。 真实的身份、熟悉的关系或掌握了某些信息，都不能确立任何进一步的权限。

paragraphs.en: Public reports illustrate that authorization risks can arise from a mismatch between a user’s understanding and the system’s permitted execution scope, even without an obvious unauthorized action. In September 2026, Matt Robb reported that Meta Muse, while handling Facebook Marketplace messages for him, sent a buyer his residential pickup address and arranged collection; the buyer subsequently arrived at his building. Robb later explained that he had selected Allow Always but had expected important steps such as accepting offers to require further confirmation. The setting in fact allowed automatic messages containing the pickup address. Later reporting stated that, after discussions with Meta staff, Robb attributed part of the problem to permission settings and said Meta was considering clearer prompts [ 21 ] . These reports do not independently establish an authorization bypass. They more directly illustrate a governance problem: authorizing message handling should not leave a user unclear about whether address disclosure, transaction confirmation, or in-person meetings are also authorized. Platforms should test consistency among interface wording, what users actually confirm, and the operations the agent can execute.
paragraphs.zh: 公开报告表明，即使用户没有明显的未授权操作，授权风险也可能因用户理解与系统允许执行范围之间的不匹配而产生。 2026年9月，Matt Robb 报告称，Meta Muse 在替他处理 Facebook Marketplace 消息时，向一位买家发送了他的住址取货地址并安排了取货；该买家随后到达了他的楼栋。 Robb 后来解释说，他选择了“始终允许”，但原本预期接受报价等重要步骤需要进一步确认。 该设置实际上允许了包含取货地址的自动消息。 后续报道称，与 Meta 工作人员讨论后，Robb 将问题部分归因于权限设置，并表示 Meta 正在考虑提供更清晰的提示 [ 21 ] 。 这些报告并不能独立证明存在授权绕过。 它们更直接地揭示了一个治理问题：授权消息处理不应让用户不清楚地址披露、交易确认或线下会面是否也在授权范围内。 平台应测试界面措辞、用户实际确认的内容与智能体可执行操作之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Another risk is confusing access to information with authority to make commitments. Consider the following hypothetical illustration: an external service agent finds an old booking link in internal notes and promises a client a meeting without checking current availability or the participants’ consent. It may also infer an unapproved fee or send internal client-routing notes directly to the client. Relevant safeguards include restricting the basis for quotations, separating internal analysis from external replies, and checking availability and approvals before committing another person’s time. Being able to read a document does not authorize disclosure; finding a booking link does not authorize a commitment of someone’s time; calculating a price does not authorize quoting it. This illustration is not an independently verified incident and cannot be used to estimate accident rates.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个风险是把访问信息与作出承诺的权限混为一谈。 考虑以下假设性示例：一名外部服务智能体在内部笔记中找到一个旧的预订链接，在没有核实当前空闲情况或参与者同意的情况下，就向客户承诺安排一次会议。 它还可能推断出一个未经批准的费用，或者把内部客户分派笔记直接发送给客户。 相关的保障措施包括限制报价依据、将内部分析与对外回复分开，以及在占用他人时间之前核实空闲情况和获得批准。 能够读取一份文件并不意味着有权披露它；找到一个预订链接并不意味着有权承诺他人的时间；计算出一个价格并不意味着有权对外报价。 此示例并非经过独立核实的事故，不能用于估算事故发生率。

paragraphs.en: DelegateEval translates these risks into separately verifiable requirements for authorization enforcement, disclosure, commitment management, escalation, duplicate-action prevention, recovery, and data use. Critical actions are recorded at three levels: agent proposal, platform submission, and actual environmental effect. If the platform blocks an unauthorized proposal, the agent’s judgment failed while the safeguard worked. An authorized action that never takes effect is not successful delivery. Confirmed unauthorized execution receives a separate safety assessment, whose decision rules will be specified in a future protocol. Ordinary requests should be paired with stress conditions so that blanket refusal is not mistaken for strong governance. Software can verify explicit identities, fields, times, versions, and permissions. Implied commitments in natural language, cumulative disclosure across turns, and domain-dependent judgments require independent review.
paragraphs.zh: DelegateEval 将这些风险转化为可分别验证的要求，涵盖授权执行、信息披露、承诺管理、升级、重复操作防范、恢复以及数据使用。 关键操作在三个层面被记录：智能体的提议、平台的提交，以及实际的环境效果。 如果平台拦截了一个未授权的提议，说明智能体的判断失败而防护机制发挥了作用。 一个从未生效的已授权操作并不构成成功的交付。 已确认的未授权执行会获得独立的安全评估，其判定规则将在未来的协议中予以规定。 普通请求应与压力条件配对，以免一刀切的拒绝被误认为强有力的治理。 软件可以验证显式的身份、字段、时间、版本和权限。 自然语言中的隐含承诺、跨轮次累积的信息披露，以及依赖领域的判断，需要独立的审查。
