paragraphs.en: Human involvement should bring each issue to someone with the authority and expertise to handle it, at the time a decision is needed. Clients normally confirm clarified requirements, the principal sets global service rules, and qualified reviewers assess professional quality. If one person holds several roles, record the role in which that person intervenes. Automated checks, sampled human review, professional verification, approval to send, and direct takeover are distinct interventions, not a ranking of capabilities. Reviewing an artifact does not authorize its disclosure, and approving an invitation does not confirm that the invitees will attend. Tests should check whether required escalations are timely and contain enough information, and whether matters that are already clear are referred to humans unnecessarily. Repeated requests for guidance must not count as repeated successes. Record the outcomes after takeover and the time spent.
paragraphs.zh: 人工介入应在需要决策时，将每个问题转交给有权限和专业知识处理该问题的人。 客户通常负责确认已澄清的需求，委托方设定全局服务规则，合格的评审者评估专业质量。 如果一个人担任多个角色，应记录该人介入时所使用的角色。 自动化检查、抽样人工审查、专业核验、发送审批和直接接管是不同类型的介入，而非能力的排名。 审查某个产出物并不意味着授权披露它，批准某个邀请并不意味着确认受邀者将会出席。 测试应检查必要的升级是否及时且包含足够的信息，以及是否将已经明确的事项不必要地转交给了人工。 反复请求指导不得被计为反复成功。 记录接管后的结果以及所花费的时间。

paragraphs.en: Tests must also cover rule changes while actions are in progress. If authorization is withdrawn after an agent proposes an action but before the platform submits it, check the action against the authorization valid at submission and record when the withdrawal became visible to the system. Before retrying after a network error or ambiguous response, check the task identifier, parameters, and existing receipts to avoid duplicate execution or charges. After a failure, recovery should establish which matters remain unfinished and which permissions are current, rather than replay every interrupted action. Restoring operation tests reliability; correctly continuing earlier business matters also provides evidence of service continuity.
paragraphs.zh: 测试还必须覆盖动作进行过程中规则发生变更的情形。 如果在智能体提出某个动作之后、平台提交该动作之前授权被撤回，则应根据提交时有效的授权来校验该动作，并记录撤回何时对系统可见。 在因网络错误或响应不明确而重试之前，应检查任务标识符、参数和已有的回执，以避免重复执行或重复计费。 失败后的恢复应确定哪些事务仍未完成、哪些权限仍然有效，而不是重放每一个被中断的动作。 恢复运行可测试可靠性；正确地继续之前的业务事务也能提供业务连续性的证据。

paragraphs.en: Permission for current-task use, retention across tasks, and learning must be granted separately. Providing data for one task does not authorize long-term retention, knowledge-base updates, or model training. When permission changes or is withdrawn, evaluation should verify that the agreed suspension, deletion, rollback, retraining, or other response has actually occurred. Removing an entry from a retrieval database shows only that it can no longer be retrieved from that location; it does not show that the information has been removed from model parameters or other copies. Governance claims require traceable evidence. Leave unverifiable matters unresolved, and retain confirmed incidents in the record even if other scores are high, later actions are blocked, or the incident is subsequently remedied.
paragraphs.zh: 当前任务使用的许可、跨任务保留以及学习必须分别单独授予。 为某一任务提供数据并不意味着授权长期保留、知识库更新或模型训练。 当许可变更或被撤回时，评估应验证所约定的暂停、删除、回滚、重新训练或其他响应是否确实已经发生。 从检索数据库中删除某条目只能表明它无法再从该位置被检索到；并不能表明该信息已从模型参数或其他副本中移除。 治理声明需要可追溯的证据。 对无法验证的事项保持未决状态，并在记录中保留已确认的事件，即使其他评分很高、后续行动被阻止或事件随后已得到补救。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency and value assesses whether clients receive better results and individuals can serve more clients with the time available. DelegateEval considers all three parties: whether clients can obtain better services, principals avoid repeated effort, and platforms support the service at a reasonable cost. These questions require measuring quality, time, labor, and cost together. Token counts and cheap model calls alone do not establish efficiency. Prior agent-evaluation work likewise warns that accuracy alone can hide the real cost of a system and recommends comparing outcomes and costs jointly, including Pareto trade-offs across systems [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 效率与价值评估的是客户是否获得更好的结果，以及个人能否在可用时间内服务更多客户。 DelegateEval 考虑了三方：客户能否获得更好的服务，委托方能否避免重复劳动，以及平台能否以合理成本支持该服务。 这些问题需要将质量、时间、人力和成本放在一起衡量。 仅凭 token 计数和廉价模型调用并不能确立效率。 以往的智能体评估工作同样警告，仅看准确率可能掩盖系统的真实成本，并建议将结果与成本联合比较，包括跨系统的帕累托权衡 [ 15 ]。

paragraphs.en: For clients, value may mean better results, less effort, or access to a service that was previously difficult to obtain. A client preparing an industry report with general-purpose AI might spend two hours explaining context, selecting sources, checking numbers, and revising conclusions. With an industry expert’s agent, the client might only state the objective and inspect the result, while the agent follows the expert’s maintained methods. Evaluation should separately record final quality, preparation, selection, waiting and verification time, revisions, and acceptance of incorrect results, rather than rely on perceived convenience. In a randomized experiment with 453 professionals, Noy and Zhang found that ChatGPT reduced average completion time by about 40% and improved output quality by about 18% on midlevel professional writing tasks [ 16 ] . Time and quality can change simultaneously and should both be measured.
paragraphs.zh: 对客户而言，价值可能意味着更好的结果、更少的投入，或能够获得以前难以获取的服务。 使用通用 AI 撰写行业报告的客户，可能要花两个小时解释背景、挑选资料来源、核对数字并修改结论。 而使用行业专家的智能体时，客户只需说明目标并检查结果，由智能体遵循该专家所维护的方法完成工作。 评估应分别记录最终质量、准备工作、选择、等待与核验时间、修改次数以及对错误结果的接受情况，而不应仅依赖主观感受上的便利。 在一项有 453 名专业人士参与的随机实验中，Noy 和 Zhang 发现，在中等难度的专业写作任务上，ChatGPT 将平均完成时间缩短了约 40%，并将产出质量提升了约 18% [ 16 ] 。 时间与质量可能同时发生变化，因此两者都应加以测量。

paragraphs.en: A distinctive potential benefit is that one hour of a person’s expertise could support more accepted services rather than only one client. Suppose an expert previously spent 60 minutes personally serving each client. If an agent handles most information gathering, initial assessment, and output generation, leaving an average of six minutes of expert review at critical points, one hour could in principle support about ten service instances. If, further, 80% of low-risk tasks need no personal intervention and only complex or high-risk matters are escalated, capacity could extend beyond the time available for direct personal work. Evaluation should therefore record the principal’s time per accepted service and accepted services per hour of the principal’s time, rather than only the number of tasks completed by the platform.
paragraphs.zh: 一个独特的潜在好处是，一个人的专业知识中的一小时可以支持更多被接受的服务，而不只是服务一位客户。 假设一位专家过去每次亲自服务一位客户需要花费60分钟。 如果智能体承担大部分信息收集、初步评估和成果生成工作，只在关键节点平均留下六分钟的专家审核时间，那么一小时原则上可以支持大约十个服务实例。 如果进一步做到80%的低风险任务无需本人介入、仅复杂或高风险事项才升级处理，服务能力就可能超出可用于直接亲自工作的时间。 因此，评估应记录每项被接受服务所消耗的委托人时间，以及每单位委托人时间所支持的被接受服务数量，而不仅仅是平台完成的任务数量。

paragraphs.en: This service leverage may vary across people and tasks, so evaluation must examine subgroups as well as averages. Brynjolfsson, Li, and Raymond’s 2023 working paper, based on 5,179 customer-support workers, reported an average increase of about 14% in issues resolved per hour with generative AI, concentrated among less experienced and lower-skilled workers; gains for highly experienced workers were substantially smaller [ 17 ] . Three randomized field experiments involving 4,867 developers at Microsoft, Accenture, and another large company reported an overall increase of about 26% in completed tasks with an AI coding assistant, with higher adoption and productivity gains among less experienced developers [ 18 ] . DelegateEval should therefore distinguish clients’ domain experience, AI proficiency, and dependence on a provider’s expertise rather than report only average time savings.
paragraphs.zh: 这种服务增益在不同人群和不同任务之间可能存在差异，因此评估不仅要考察平均值，还要考察子群体。 Brynjolfsson、Li 和 Raymond 2023 年基于 5,179 名客服人员的工作论文报告称，使用生成式 AI 后每小时解决的问题数量平均增加约 14%，且增益集中在经验较少、技能较低的工作者身上；经验丰富的工作者的收益则要小得多 [ 17 ] 。 三项涉及 Microsoft、Accenture 以及另一家大型公司共 4,867 名开发者的随机田野实验报告称，使用 AI 编码助手后完成的任务总体增加约 26%，其中经验较少的开发者采用率更高、生产力增益也更大 [ 18 ] 。 因此，DelegateEval 应当区分客户在特定领域的经验、对 AI 的熟练程度以及对提供方专业知识的依赖程度，而不能只报告平均节省的时间。

sents.en: DelegateEval should therefore distinguish clients’ domain experience, AI proficiency, and dependence on a provider’s expertise rather than report only average time savings.
sents.zh: 因此，DelegateEval 应当区分客户在特定领域的经验、对 AI 的熟练程度以及对提供方专业知识的依赖程度，而不能只报告平均节省的时间。

paragraphs.en: Those who benefit most may also have the greatest difficulty identifying errors. A client who cannot code may greatly need an engineer’s agent yet struggle to detect regressions. A client unfamiliar with nutrition may rely heavily on expert assistance while being less able to recognize incorrect explanations. Client burden must therefore include whether critical errors are detected, not just minutes spent checking. Decision time, verification time, and incorrect-result acceptance should be recorded separately. Spending only five minutes checking an artifact does not establish value if the client accepts it despite an important error.
paragraphs.zh: 获益最多的人可能也最难识别错误。 不会编程的客户可能非常需要工程师的智能体，却难以察觉功能退化。 不熟悉营养学的客户可能高度依赖专家协助，同时较难识别错误的解释。 因此，客户负担必须包括是否发现了关键错误，而不仅仅是花了多少分钟检查。 决策时间、验证时间和接受错误结果的情况应分别记录。 如果客户在存在重要错误的情况下仍接受了产物，那么仅花五分钟检查并不能证明其价值。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency gains must not be assumed, because AI can have opposite effects across tasks and users. In a 2025 randomized study of 16 experienced open-source developers working in familiar repositories, METR found that allowing AI tools increased completion time by about 19%. Participants had roughly five years of experience with their repositories on average and expected, both before and after the study, that AI would make them faster [ 19 ] . Perceived convenience and more advanced agents are therefore insufficient evidence of efficiency. DelegateEval should use measured time, actual artifacts, and independent acceptance, retaining heterogeneous effects in the results rather than discarding them as outliers.
paragraphs.zh: 效率提升不能被想当然，因为 AI 在不同任务和不同用户身上可能产生相反的效果。 在 2025 年一项针对 16 名在熟悉代码库中工作的资深开源开发者的随机研究中，METR 发现允许使用 AI 工具会使完成时间增加约 19%。 参与者平均对其代码库拥有约五年的经验，并且在研究前后都预期 AI 会让他们更快 [ 19 ]。 因此，感知到的便利性以及更先进的智能体并不足以证明效率的存在。 DelegateEval 应使用实测时间、实际产出物和独立验收，并在结果中保留异质性效应，而不是将其作为异常值丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Full-cost accounting must establish whether work has been eliminated or shifted from the client to someone else. A client may save an hour because an agent does the work, or because a principal, expert reviewer, or platform operator spends an additional hour. Time must be recorded separately for all of these parties. Costs should include inference, software and API calls, training or updates, failed attempts and retries, maintenance, and recovery. Client prices must be distinguished from actual resource costs. If time is converted into money, the rate should be stated; raw minutes or hours may also be retained. Failed tasks still incur time and expense, which must not disappear from accounting because no acceptable artifact was delivered.
paragraphs.zh: 全成本核算必须确认工作究竟是被消除了，还是从委托方转移给了其他人。 委托方节省一小时，可能是因为智能体完成了这项工作，也可能是因为委托人、专家审阅者或平台运营者多花了一小时。 必须为上述所有各方分别记录时间。 成本应包括推理、软件和 API 调用、训练或更新、失败的尝试和重试、维护以及恢复。 必须将委托方价格与实际资源成本区分开来。 如果将时间换算成金钱，应注明费率；也可以保留原始的分钟数或小时数。 失败的任务仍然会产生时间和费用，不能因为没有交付可接受的成果就从核算中消失。

paragraphs.en: Cost accounting should distinguish establishing a service from serving an additional client. Organizing knowledge, configuring rules, preparing examples, integrating tools, and training models are initial setup costs. Inference, software use, and personal review for another client are marginal service costs. Knowledge updates, model maintenance, and operations are ongoing maintenance costs. A service requiring 100 hours of setup followed by five minutes of personal effort per ordinary client has different scaling properties from one still requiring 50 minutes for every new client. Long-term comparisons can report setup, marginal, and maintenance costs alongside amortized cost per service rather than combine them without distinction.
paragraphs.zh: 成本核算应区分建立一项服务与为 additional client 提供服务这两件事。 组织知识、配置规则、准备示例、集成工具以及训练模型都属于初始建设成本。 为另一位客户进行推理、使用软件以及人工审阅，则属于边际服务成本。 知识更新、模型维护与日常运营属于持续维护成本。 一项需要 100 小时初始建设、之后每位普通客户只需五分钟人工投入的服务，与一项对每个新客户仍需 50 分钟人工投入的服务，其扩展特性截然不同。 长期比较可以分别报告初始建设成本、边际成本与维护成本，以及按每次服务分摊的成本，而不应不加区分地将它们混在一起。

sents.zh: 成本核算应区分建立一项服务与为 additional client 提供服务这两件事。

paragraphs.en: Providers may host their own agents on spare personal computers or rented resources, alongside the option of platform-managed hosting. They can adjust spending to demand and revenue while paying for depreciation, electricity, networking, storage, and model calls. A centralized personal-assistant platform may otherwise supply cloud execution and subsidize free users. With provider-managed hosting, the platform could instead focus on discovery, commissioning, settlement, and trusted governance without maintaining a complete execution environment for every provider. Having providers cover some computing and operating expenses could reduce a new platform’s upfront funding needs and its spending on execution resources as services grow. Here, distributed operation refers to where agents run and who pays; it does not require all foundation models to run locally.
paragraphs.zh: 提供者可以在闲置的个人电脑或租用的资源上托管自己的智能体，也可以选择由平台托管的托管方式。 他们可以根据需求和收入调整支出，同时支付折旧、电力、网络、存储和模型调用费用。 集中式个人助理平台则可能提供云端执行并为免费用户提供补贴。 采用提供者管理的托管方式后，平台可以转而专注于发现、委托、结算和可信治理，而无需为每个提供者维护完整的执行环境。 由提供者承担部分计算和运营费用，可以降低新平台的前期资金需求及其随服务增长而产生的执行资源支出。 这里所说的分布式运行，指的是智能体在哪里运行以及由谁付费；它并不要求所有基础模型都在本地运行。

paragraphs.en: Moving expenses to providers does not by itself reduce total cost or make the service profitable. Platforms still pay for coordination and governance, and providers may incur equipment costs and pay to keep their agents online before earning any revenue. Revenue must cover operation, maintenance, and necessary human review; viability also depends on reliable, secure nodes with sufficient availability. DelegateEval should report platform and provider costs separately. It should compare total cost per accepted delivery and providers’ net returns under matched quality, safety, and load conditions, counting any additional coordination, monitoring, and recovery overhead. Cost transfers must not be counted as efficiency gains. Whether this arrangement lowers expansion costs and supports sustainable operation remains a question for operational data.
paragraphs.zh: 把开支转移给提供方本身并不会降低总成本，也不会使服务变得盈利。 平台仍需为协调和治理付费，而提供方在获得任何收入之前，可能需要承担设备成本并为保持其智能体在线而付费。 收入必须覆盖运营、维护和必要的人工审核；可行性还依赖于具备足够可用性的可靠、安全的节点。 DelegateEval 应分别报告平台成本和提供方成本。 在质量、安全和负载条件匹配的情况下，它应比较每单被接受交付的总成本以及提供方的净回报，并将额外的协调、监控和恢复开销计入其中。 成本转移不得被计为效率提升。 这种安排是否能降低扩张成本并支持可持续运营，仍需由运营数据来回答。

paragraphs.en: Scalability concerns whether personal effort grows substantially more slowly than accepted service volume while quality and risk remain controlled. An agent might handle five requests per day on time but develop a rapidly growing approval queue at 50 requests, with P95 waiting time rising from ten minutes to eight hours. Low average cost would not establish scalability in that case. Tests must distinguish total workload, simultaneous arrivals, and sustained load, tracking acceptance rate, throughput, queueing, P90/P95 latency, backlog, personal intervention time, and risk. Recent research on agent reliability also emphasizes that average success rates can conceal consistency, robustness, and failure severity, reinforcing the need to assess more than averages when scaling [ 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 可扩展性关注的是，在质量和风险保持可控的前提下，个人投入的增长是否显著慢于被接受的服务量。 一个智能体可能每天能按时处理五个请求，但在 50 个请求时会形成快速增长的处理队列，P95 等待时间从十分钟上升到八小时。 在这种情况下，较低的平均成本并不能证明其可扩展性。 测试必须区分总工作量、并发到达和持续负载，并跟踪接受率、吞吐量、排队情况、P90/P95 延迟、积压、个人干预时间和风险。 关于智能体可靠性的近期研究也强调，平均成功率可能掩盖一致性、鲁棒性和失败严重程度，这进一步说明在扩展时需要评估平均指标之外的内容 [ 20 ] 。

sents.zh: 关于智能体可靠性的近期研究也强调，平均成功率可能掩盖一致性、鲁棒性和失败严重程度，这进一步说明在扩展时需要评估平均指标之外的内容 [ 20 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Client value may decline as services grow; more choices, agents, or concurrency are not benefits in themselves. In Magentic Marketplace’s simulated two-sided agent market, search quality directly affected consumer welfare. Several models exhibited choice overload and lower consumer welfare as candidate sets expanded, and agent performance could deteriorate substantially at larger market scales [ 10 ] . For DelegateEval, having ten thousand external service agents is not inherently better than having one hundred. Evaluation must establish whether clients find appropriate providers more easily, receive better services, and retain these benefits as the platform grows.
paragraphs.zh: 随着服务规模扩大，客户端价值可能下降；更多的选择、智能体或并发本身并不构成好处。 在 Magentic Marketplace 模拟的双边智能体市场中，搜索质量直接影响消费者福利。 随着候选集扩大，一些模型表现出选择过载和消费者福利下降的现象，而在更大的市场规模下，智能体的性能可能大幅退化 [ 10 ] 。 对于 DelegateEval 而言，拥有一万个外部服务智能体并不天然优于一百个。 评估必须确定客户端是否更容易找到合适的服务提供者、获得更好的服务，以及随着平台成长是否能持续保有这些收益。

paragraphs.en: Long-term value also includes whether repeat collaboration requires less effort than the first commission. A first-time client may need to explain project context, technology choices, and delivery preferences to an engineer’s agent. By the tenth commission, correctly carried-forward information that the system is authorized to retain may allow the client to state only the new requirement. Initial and repeat commissions can be compared for explanation time, verification time, interventions by the principal, and maintenance cost. Persisting incorrect history is not valuable simply because it saves the client a few sentences. Long-term efficiency must therefore be interpreted with continuity and reliable governance.
paragraphs.zh: 长期价值还包括重复协作是否比首次委托需要更少的精力。 新客户可能需要向工程师的智能体解释项目背景、技术选择和交付偏好。 到第十次委托时，系统经授权保留的正确延续信息，可能让客户只需说明新的需求。 可以对首次委托和重复委托就解释时间、验证时间、委托人的干预次数以及维护成本进行比较。 持久保存错误的历史记录并不会仅仅因为为客户省下几句话就有价值。 因此，必须结合连续性和可靠治理来解读长期效率。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency and value should ultimately identify who benefits and who bears additional costs, rather than collapse all outcomes into a single higher-is-better score. A system may save client effort while increasing expert review, multiply service volume tenfold at higher platform compute cost, or minimize cost while reducing quality or increasing risk. DelegateEval therefore prioritizes the underlying measures of delivery quality, client burden, personal effort, system cost, and service scale, and compares their trade-offs under common quality and safety constraints. Consistent with AI Agents That Matter [ 15 ] , joint performance-and-cost evaluation and Pareto comparisons are more informative than rankings based on one metric.
paragraphs.zh: 效率与价值最终应当厘清谁受益、谁承担额外成本，而不是把所有结果压缩成一个越高越好的单一分数。 一个系统可能在节省客户精力的同时增加专家审核，可能在以更高的平台计算成本将服务量扩大十倍，也可能在最小化成本的同时降低质量或增加风险。 因此，DelegateEval 优先关注交付质量、客户负担、个人精力、系统成本和服务规模这些底层度量，并在共同的质量与安全约束下比较它们之间的权衡。 与 AI Agents That Matter [ 15 ] 的观点一致，性能与成本的联合评估以及帕累托比较，比基于单一指标的排名更具信息量。

paragraphs.en: DelegateEval is an evaluation framework; it is not yet a complete, executable benchmark. This paper defines the scope, eight quality dimensions, task types, acceptance principles, and experimental designs. We have not yet assembled complete datasets, executable environments, a unified scoring protocol, or cross-model results. The task taxonomy, proposed cases, and diagrams explain how evaluation could work; they do not form a runnable test suite or constitute empirical evidence. These components must be completed before other researchers can run the evaluation, inspect its evidence, and compare results under clearly specified conditions.
paragraphs.zh: DelegateEval 是一个评估框架；它还不是完整、可执行的基准测试。 本文界定了该框架的范围、八个质量维度、任务类型、验收原则和实验设计。 我们尚未构建完整的数据集、可执行的运行环境、统一的评分协议或跨模型的结果。 任务分类法、提出的用例和图示说明了评估可以如何运作；它们并不构成可运行的测试套件，也不构成实证证据。 在其他研究者能够运行该评估、检查其证据并在明确规定的条件下比较结果之前，必须先完成这些组件。

sents.zh: DelegateEval 是一个评估框架；它还不是完整、可执行的基准测试。

paragraphs.en: The task types and proposed cases do not yet form a complete dataset. Publishable inputs, principal knowledge and method configurations, client requests, event sequences, reference artifacts, and independent acceptance materials have not been fully assembled. Coverage, sample size, and training, development, and test splits remain unspecified. Dataset development must establish how samples are organized across principals, clients, and time, how creation failures remain represented, and whether shared materials or histories cause test leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 任务类型与提出的案例尚未构成完整的数据集。 可发布的输入、主体知识与方法的配置、客户请求、事件序列、参考工件以及独立的验收材料尚未完全汇集。 覆盖范围、样本规模以及训练集、开发集和测试集的划分仍未确定。 数据集的开发必须明确样本如何按主体、客户和时间进行组织，创建失败如何继续被表示，以及共享材料或历史是否会导致测试集信息泄漏。

sents.zh: 任务类型与提出的案例尚未构成完整的数据集。

sents.zh: 可发布的输入、主体知识与方法的配置、客户请求、事件序列、参考工件以及独立的验收材料尚未完全汇集。

paragraphs.en: Acceptance principles have not yet been implemented as a unified scoring and reporting protocol. Although the paper distinguishes diagnostic scores, overall acceptance, safety thresholds, and insufficient evidence, executable scoring scripts, review rubrics, and complete statistical procedures remain to be developed. Observation units, denominators, timeouts and failures, missing evidence and inapplicable items, repeated runs, weights, and thresholds must be predefined. Open-ended tasks require reviewer calibration. The protocol must establish comparable measurements while retaining domain-specific acceptance requirements and preventing double counting across tasks or dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 验收原则尚未被实现为统一的评分与报告协议。 尽管该论文区分了诊断性分数、总体验收、安全阈值和证据不足等类别，但可执行的评分脚本、评审细则和完整的统计流程仍有待开发。 观察单元、分母、超时与失败、缺失证据与不适用项、重复运行、权重和阈值都必须预先定义。 开放式任务需要对评审者进行校准。 该协议必须建立可比较的度量，同时保留特定领域的验收要求，并防止跨任务或跨维度的重复计算。

paragraphs.en: Cross-model baselines and controlled comparisons are also absent. No comparison across model families and sizes has yet been conducted under a common dataset, environment, and protocol, and evidence is insufficient to separate foundation-model, personal-resource, platform, and human contributions. Platform conclusions therefore cannot yet be assumed to hold after a model change, nor can an adaptation gain on one model establish an overall service advantage. Personal knowledge adaptation, memory, skills, and workflows require controlled comparisons and ablations with explicit resource conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 跨模型基线和受控比较同样缺失。 目前尚未在共同的数据集、环境和协议下进行跨模型家族和模型规模的比较，证据不足以区分基础模型、个人资源、平台和人的贡献。 因此，平台层面的结论不能被假定在更换模型后仍然成立，也不能凭在某一模型上的适应增益来确立整体服务优势。 个人知识适应、记忆、技能和工作流需要在不同资源条件下进行显式的受控比较和消融实验。

paragraphs.en: These gaps limit the empirical conclusions. Usability for real creators, rubric validity, long-term continuity, learning gains, scalability, economic sustainability, and governance remain to be validated. They are questions for subsequent evaluation. The current framework does not establish platform rankings, high service leverage, or profitability. The absence of observed safety incidents would likewise not establish long-term safety on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 这些缺口限制了实证结论。 对真实创作者的可用性、评分标准的有效性、长期连续性、学习收益、可扩展性、经济可持续性以及治理机制，仍有待验证。 这些是后续评估要解决的问题。 当前框架并未确立平台排名、高服务杠杆或盈利能力。 未观察到安全事故，同样不能仅凭这一点就确立长期安全性。

paragraphs.en: The first step is a complete, clearly scoped initial dataset. Code modification, research reports, document maintenance, and tutoring are suitable starting points. Proposed cases should be developed into tasks containing principal configurations, client requests, authorized materials, event timelines, reference artifacts, and independent acceptance evidence. Splits should be organized by principal, project, and shared history, with near-duplicate tasks and source leakage checked. Professional and technical backgrounds, material completeness, and creation failures should be recorded. The first release may be small, but its dimensional coverage must be explicit so that it supports later expansion and experiments with real participants.
paragraphs.zh: 第一步是一个完整的、范围清晰的初始数据集。 代码修改、研究报告、文档维护和辅导是合适的起点。 提出的案例应被开发为包含委托方配置、客户请求、授权材料、事件时间线、参考产物和独立验收证据的任务。 划分应按委托方、项目和共享历史来组织，并检查近似重复的任务和来源泄露。 专业技术背景、材料完整性和创建失败情况都应被记录。 首次发布规模可以较小，但其维度覆盖必须明确，以便支持后续扩展和与真实参与者进行的实验。

sents.zh: 第一步是一个完整的、范围清晰的初始数据集。

paragraphs.en: The second step is an executable, inspectable evaluation environment. It should implement creation, service episodes, and replay of longitudinal service histories, fix tool and dependency versions, and support state resets, event injection, authorization changes, recovery, sealed artifact submissions, and log export. Evaluators and verifiers must be isolated from the tested system. Accepted artifacts, known defects, reasonable alternatives, and missing-evidence packages should be used to check verifier validity. Installation instructions, configuration examples, and end-to-end examples should allow independent researchers to reproduce acceptance from raw materials while distinguishing environment failures from system failures.
paragraphs.zh: 第二步是一个可执行、可检查的评估环境。 它应实现创建、服务回合以及长期服务历史记录的回放，固定工具与依赖版本，并支持状态重置、事件注入、授权变更、恢复、密封工件提交以及日志导出。 评估者与验证者必须与被测系统隔离。 应使用已接受的工件、已知缺陷、合理的替代方案以及缺失证据包来检验验证者的有效性。 安装说明、配置示例和端到端示例应使独立研究者能够从原始材料复现验收过程，同时区分环境故障与系统故障。

sents.en: The second step is an executable, inspectable evaluation environment.
sents.zh: 第二步是一个可执行、可检查的评估环境。

sents.en: It should implement creation, service episodes, and replay of longitudinal service histories, fix tool and dependency versions, and support state resets, event injection, authorization changes, recovery, sealed artifact submissions, and log export.
sents.zh: 它应实现创建、服务回合以及长期服务历史记录的回放，固定工具与依赖版本，并支持状态重置、事件注入、授权变更、恢复、密封工件提交以及日志导出。

sents.en: Evaluators and verifiers must be isolated from the tested system.
sents.zh: 评估者与验证者必须与被测系统隔离。

sents.en: Accepted artifacts, known defects, reasonable alternatives, and missing-evidence packages should be used to check verifier validity.
sents.zh: 应使用已接受的工件、已知缺陷、合理的替代方案以及缺失证据包来检验验证者的有效性。

sents.en: Installation instructions, configuration examples, and end-to-end examples should allow independent researchers to reproduce acceptance from raw materials while distinguishing environment failures from system failures.
sents.zh: 安装说明、配置示例和端到端示例应使独立研究者能够从原始材料复现验收过程，同时区分环境故障与系统故障。

paragraphs.en: Pilot experiments with creators and clients from different backgrounds should calibrate scoring criteria and agreement among reviewers. Before formal testing, fix task endpoints, resource and human budgets, scoring rules, acceptance criteria, and exception handling. Use this common protocol to compare foundation-model families and sizes, personal knowledge configurations, model adaptation, and workflow changes, measuring gains on held-out tasks, retention, and cost. Report the eight dimensions, accepted deliveries, safety incidents, and human effort separately, and repeat runs to assess stability. Release the versions, configurations, and logs needed to distinguish the contributions of foundation models, personal expertise, platform mechanisms, and additional human labor. The initial benchmark is complete when others can independently run and check its data, environment, protocol, and cross-model results. Subsequent work can then study real services over 30 and 90 days and test different loads, examining long-term learning, authorization changes, scale, and economic value. Report simulated business time separately from actual elapsed time. Release substantive changes to data or protocols as new versions and retain earlier results for comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 应通过与不同背景的创作者和客户进行试点实验，来校准评分标准以及评审者之间的一致性。 在正式测试之前，需固定任务终点、资源与人力预算、评分规则、验收标准以及异常处理方式。 使用这一通用协议来比较基础模型的系列与规模、个人知识配置、模型适配以及工作流变更，并在留存任务上测量收益、保持度与成本。 分别报告八个维度、被验收的交付物、安全事件以及人力投入，并重复运行以评估稳定性。 发布区分基础模型、个人专业知识、平台机制与额外人力劳动各自贡献所需的版本、配置和日志。 当他人能够独立运行并核查基准的数据、环境、协议与跨模型结果时，初始基准即告完成。 后续工作可以进而研究 30 天和 90 天的真实服务并测试不同负载，考察长期学习、授权变更、规模与经济价值。 将模拟的业务时间与实际流逝时间分开报告。 对数据或协议的实质性变更以新版本发布，并保留早期结果以供比较。
